evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-plugin-balance

给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 客户端加一个**侧栏「余额」入口**，点开是一整块主面板：

- 当前余额 + 水位条（>¥50 绿 / ¥10–50 琥珀 / <¥10 红）
- 赠送 / 充值拆分、更新时间
- 今日 / 本月消耗（本地采样）
- 去充值按钮、换 Key

## 形态

```
侧栏                    主面板
─────────────────────  ──────────────────────────────
🆕 新会话              DeepSeek 余额           [刷新] [换 Key]
📁 工作区              ¥ 73.62
🧩 插件                赠送 ¥0.00 · 充值 ¥73.62
💰 余额  ← 新增        ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░░  74%
                       今日 ¥1.13   本月 ¥45.67   可用
                       [去充值]
```

## 实现要点

| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧栏入口 | `ctx.slots.register({ name: "sidebar.panellist", id: "balance", order: 30, label })` |
| 主面板 | `ctx.slots.register({ name: "main", key: "balance" }, Panel)`（`main` 是 root 作用域的 keyed slot） |
| 数据来源 | 客户端直接 `fetch https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` —— 该接口回显 Origin 并允许凭据，所以**不需要主机路由** |
| Key 存储 | localStorage + cookie 双写（端口每次启动会变，cookie 按 host 存才不会丢） |
| 消耗统计 | 每次成功查询往本地历史里采样，相邻采样的**下降**计为消耗，充值（上升）不计 |

主机半边（`lib/index.js`）是空实现，纯粹为了让 loader 条目合法。

## 安装

已安装到 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`：

```
profiles/desktop/
├─ plugins/dsh-plugin-balance/          ← 插件本体
├─ node_modules/dsh-plugin-balance      ← junction 指向上面的目录
├─ package.json                         ← dependencies + dsh.profile.bundles 各加一条
└─ cordis.patch.yml                     ← 不需要改（bundle 自带 patch）
```

`package.json` 里：

```json
"dependencies": { "dsh-plugin-balance": "file:./plugins/dsh-plugin-balance" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-plugin-balance" ] } }
```

插件自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，由 bundle 层插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-plugin-balance
      name: dsh-plugin-balance
```

## 卸载 / 回滚

```bat
:: 1) 从 bundles 里摘掉并删目录
::    （或直接用备份还原）
copy "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json.bak-*" "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json"
rmdir /s /q "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-plugin-balance"
rmdir /s /q "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-plugin-balance"
```

## 开发

```bat
:: 语法检查
node --check lib/client.js
:: 桩环境跑注册逻辑（不需要 DSH）
node test-apply.cjs
```

改完 `lib/*.js` 后复制到 profile 的 `plugins/dsh-plugin-balance/`，刷新页面即可（HMR 已开启；
若侧栏没出现，重启一次 DSH）。

## 三个座位（v0.2）

| 座位 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation.session.header.actions` | **聊天头部的小胶囊**：`● ¥73.62`，不用切面板就能看到；点它跳到余额面板 |
| `sidebar.panellist` | 侧栏「余额」入口 |
| `main` | 完整面板（水位、今日/本月、去充值） |

没配 Key 时胶囊不渲染（不占位）；请求失败时显示 `Key 无效` / `余额 ?` + 悬停看原因。
三个座位共享同一个 60 秒轮询 store，只发一份请求。

## v0.3：会话花费 + 本轮消耗 + 动效

新增两个座位：

| 座位 | 显示 |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.session.row.leading` | 每个会话后面的估算花费（`¥5.42`），悬停看 token 数 |
| `conversation.input.dock` | 输入框上方一行：`本轮 ¥0.051`｜`今日 ¥1.13`｜`余额 ¥73.62` |

数据来自 session 投影 `projectionValues.tokenUsage`：
`totals`（累计）/ `last.buckets`（上一轮）。座位渲染器会注入 `sessionId` 和 `useSessions`。

计价规则（面板里可改，默认 ¥2/¥8 每百万 token）：

```
cost = (uncachedInput + cacheWrite + cacheRead × 0.25) × 输入单价
     + output × 输出单价            ÷ 1M
```

缓存命中按 1/4 计，与官方缓存价一致。**这是估算**，不是账单。

动效（纯 CSS + rAF，不引依赖）：

- 数字滚动：余额变化时 73.20 → 73.62 过渡
- 迷你水位：胶囊内的横向填充条，宽度 = 余额/100
- 低余额呼吸：<¥10 时状态点做 1.6s 明暗循环
- 刷新转圈：请求中 ⟳ 旋转
- 变化闪烁：余额下降时胶囊背景/描边闪一下
# DSH 插件集 · deepseek-harness plugins

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/) 桌面端写的两个客户端插件：**余额监控**与 **科幻 HUD 背景**。

| 插件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [`dsh-plugin-balance`](packages/balance) | 实时余额、会话花费、官方价目计费、低余额告警 |
| [`dsh-plugin-hud`](packages/hud) | 状态驱动的科幻背景：思考/输出/打字各有光效 |

两个插件可以单独使用，也可以一起用（余额低于阈值时 HUD 整屏转红）。

---

## 目录

- [快速安装](#快速安装)
- [dsh-plugin-balance · 余额](#dsh-plugin-balance--余额)
- [dsh-plugin-hud · 状态光效](#dsh-plugin-hud--状态光效)
- [两者联动](#两者联动)
- [卸载](#卸载)
- [开发与验证](#开发与验证)

---

## 快速安装

插件通过 DSH 的 **profile bundle** 机制加载。以默认的 `desktop` profile 为例（Windows 路径为 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`）：

```powershell
$prof = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"

# 1. 把插件复制进 profile 的 plugins 目录
Copy-Item -Recurse packages\balance "$prof\plugins\dsh-plugin-balance"
Copy-Item -Recurse packages\hud     "$prof\plugins\dsh-plugin-hud"

# 2. 在 node_modules 下建 junction（让 loader 能按包名解析）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$prof\node_modules\dsh-plugin-balance" -Target "$prof\plugins\dsh-plugin-balance"
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$prof\node_modules\dsh-plugin-hud"     -Target "$prof\plugins\dsh-plugin-hud"
```

然后编辑 `$prof\package.json`，加两处（`dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles`）：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-balance": "file:./plugins/dsh-plugin-balance",
    "dsh-plugin-hud": "file:./plugins/dsh-plugin-hud"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-plugin-balance",
        "dsh-plugin-hud"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**重启 DSH**（新增插件必须在启动时组装，热更新只对已加载的插件生效）。

> ⚠️ 编辑 `package.json` 时不要留下 UTF-8 BOM，否则 profile 解析会失败、应用起不来。

### 验证安装

重启后：

- 侧栏出现 **「余额」** 和 **「HUD」** 两个入口；
- 聊天头部出现余额胶囊；
- 背景出现缓慢漂移的光斑与下落的数据流。

---

## dsh-plugin-balance · 余额

### 五个位置

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 聊天头部 | `● ¥40.53` 胶囊，点它打开面板 |
| 侧栏会话行 | 今日花费的相对填充（`::before`，从左往右） |
| 会话悬停卡片 | `今日花费 ¥0.29 · 11.5M tokens` |
| 侧栏列表 | 「余额」图标入口 |
| 主面板 | 余额、今日/本月、去充值、官方价目表 |

### 数据来源

余额直连 `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`（该接口回显 Origin，浏览器可直连，Key 只存在本机）。

会话花费来自会话投影 `projectionValues.tokenUsage`：

```
{ uncachedInputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, outputTokens }
```

「今日」口径：每天首次采样时把各会话的累计值记为基线，之后用**当前 − 基线**作为当天增量；跨天时把昨天最后的累计值结转成今天的基线。

### 计费（官方价目，元 / 百万 tokens）

| 模型 | 输入（未命中） | 输入（缓存命中） | 输出 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| flash | 1 | 0.02 | 4 |
| pro | 4.5 | 0.15 | 13.5 |

高峰时段（周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，北京时间）**全部 ×2**。

这套公式已用官方导出的 `amount` / `cost` CSV 逐日复算验证：21 天分毫不差，合计 ¥149.65。

### 余额档位

| 余额 | 颜色 |
| --- | --- |
| > ¥50 | 绿 |
| ¥10 – 50 | 琥珀 |
| < ¥10 | 红 |

低于阈值时发一次桌面通知（托盘气泡在部分系统会被抑制，因此用自绘卡片）。

---

## dsh-plugin-hud · 状态光效

### 五种状态

| 状态 | 触发条件 | 色相 | 视觉 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 空闲 | 2.6 秒内无活动 | 灰蓝 `212` | 背景极淡，数据流最慢 |
| 打字 | 1.6 秒内有按键/输入 | 青蓝 `188` | 输入框背后随机涟漪 + 边框泛光 |
| 思考 | 请求中但尚未吐字 | 紫罗兰 `262` | 会话行**边框**一圈光弧绕行 |
| 输出 | 聊天区 DOM 有文字增长 | 橙红 `26` | 会话行**恒长光带**从左往右扫过 |
| 告警 | 余额快照 < 阈值 | 红 `355` | 整屏暗角脉动 |

状态判定**不依赖官方状态 API**：

- 「输出」= 监听 `[data-chat-flow]` 的 DOM 变化，700ms 内有变动即为正在吐字；
- 「思考」= `[data-phase="active"]` 且本轮还没吐过字（`sawStream` 标记）；
- 「收尾」= 最后一条消息出现 `[data-slot*="turnTail"]` 或文本含「已完成/用时」，立刻回落空闲。

### 背景图层

```
#dsh-hud-root   position:fixed  z-index:0   pointer-events:none
├ .hud-plasma   径向渐变 + blur(70px)，26 秒漂移一轮
├ canvas        数字雨，30fps 上限，字符 01<>[]{}/\|+=*#%$@&
├ .hud-scan     扫描线（overlay 混合）
├ .hud-scrim    可读性暗层
└ .hud-vignette 暗角

#dsh-hud-fx     position:fixed  z-index:1   涟漪层（在界面之下）
```

整层是 `body` 的独立 fixed 图层，**不参与宿主布局**，因此不会产生列与列之间的接缝。

### 接管宿主底色

背景要透出来，必须清掉宿主的三层遮罩：

```css
body {
  --dsw-alias-bg-base:        rgba(6, 9, 13, .40) !important;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2/3: rgba(..., .40) !important;
  --dsw-specific-sidebar-fill: rgba(6, 9, 13, .28) !important;
}
[class*="frame"], [class*="sidebarCol"], [class*="centerCol"], [class*="rightbarCol"] {
  background: transparent !important;
}
```

### 设置面板

侧栏 **HUD** → 强度滑杆（0–100）、六个分层开关、告警阈值、**预览区**。

预览区可以强制播放任意状态 6 秒，用来调参而不用真发消息：

```
[空闲 · 灰蓝] [打字 · 青] [思考 · 紫] [输出 · 橙] [告警 · 红]
```

点击后按钮本身会亮成对应颜色，下方显示「预览中：输出 · 橙（6 秒后自动恢复）」。

---

## 两者联动

余额插件每次成功拉取后写入：

```js
localStorage["dsh.balance.snapshot"] = { total: 40.53, at: 1732... }
```

HUD 每 250ms 读一次，低于阈值（默认 ¥10）就把整屏切成红色告警并让数据流加速。关闭方式：HUD 面板里取消勾选「余额联动」。

---

## 卸载

```powershell
$prof = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"

Remove-Item "$prof\node_modules\dsh-plugin-hud"     # junction
Remove-Item "$prof\plugins\dsh-plugin-hud" -Recurse

# 再从 package.json 的 dependencies 与 dsh.profile.bundles 里删掉对应两行
```

重启 DSH。余额插件的 Key 存在 `localStorage` 与 cookie 中，卸载后可手动清：

```js
localStorage.removeItem("dsh.balance.key");
localStorage.removeItem("dsh.balance.history");
localStorage.removeItem("dsh.balance.day.v2");
document.cookie = "dsh_balance_key=; path=/; max-age=0";
```

---

## 开发与验证

两个插件都是**单文件客户端插件**（`lib/client.js`），通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 注册。

```powershell
# 语法检查
node --check packages/hud/lib/client.js

# 桩环境验证：座位注册 + 组件渲染
node packages/hud/test-apply.cjs
node packages/balance/test-apply.cjs
```

### 插件结构

```
packages/hud/
├── package.json          dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml
├── cordis.patch.yml      往 profile 树里插入一条 entry
├── lib/index.js          host 半侧（no-op）
└── lib/client.js         浏览器半侧（全部实现）
```

### 调试技巧

- 改 `client.js` 后 **HMR 会自动生效**，不用重启；
- 但 `<style>` 只在首次注入，所以 CSS 必须写成「复用同一个 style 标签并重写 textContent」；
- 状态机不好猜时，先把判定条件做成面板上的开关或预览按钮，比反复发消息快得多。

---

### 验证安装

重启后：

- 侧栏出现 **「余额」** 和 **「HUD」** 两个入口；
- 聊天头部出现余额胶囊；
- 背景出现缓慢漂移的光斑与下落的数据流。

---

## dsh-plugin-balance · 余额

### 五个位置

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 聊天头部 | `● ¥40.53` 胶囊，点它打开面板 |
| 侧栏会话行 | 今日花费的相对填充（`::before`，从左往右） |
| 会话悬停卡片 | `今日花费 ¥0.29 · 11.5M tokens` |
| 侧栏列表 | 「余额」图标入口 |
| 主面板 | 余额、今日/本月、去充值、官方价目表 |

### 数据来源

余额直连 `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`（该接口回显 Origin，浏览器可直连，Key 只存在本机）。

会话花费来自会话投影 `projectionValues.tokenUsage`：

```
{ uncachedInputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, outputTokens }
```

「今日」口径：每天首次采样时把各会话的累计值记为基线，之后用**当前 − 基线**作为当天增量；跨天时把昨天最后的累计值结转成今天的基线。

### 计费（官方价目，元 / 百万 tokens）

| 模型 | 输入（未命中） | 输入（缓存命中） | 输出 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| flash | 1 | 0.02 | 4 |
| pro | 4.5 | 0.15 | 13.5 |

高峰时段（周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，北京时间）**全部 ×2**。

这套公式已用官方导出的 `amount` / `cost` CSV 逐日复算验证：21 天分毫不差，合计 ¥149.65。

### 余额档位

| 余额 | 颜色 |
| --- | --- |
| > ¥50 | 绿 |
| ¥10 – 50 | 琥珀 |
| < ¥10 | 红 |

低于阈值时发一次桌面通知（托盘气泡在部分系统会被抑制，因此用自绘卡片）。

---

## dsh-plugin-hud · 状态光效

### 五种状态

| 状态 | 触发条件 | 色相 | 视觉 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 空闲 | 2.6 秒内无活动 | 灰蓝 `212` | 背景极淡，数据流最慢 |
| 打字 | 1.6 秒内有按键/输入 | 青蓝 `188` | 输入框背后随机涟漪 + 边框泛光 |
| 思考 | 请求中但尚未吐字 | 紫罗兰 `262` | 会话行**边框**一圈光弧绕行 |
| 输出 | 聊天区 DOM 有文字增长 | 橙红 `26` | 会话行**恒长光带**从左往右扫过 |
| 告警 | 余额快照 < 阈值 | 红 `355` | 整屏暗角脉动 |

状态判定**不依赖官方状态 API**：

- 「输出」= 监听 `[data-chat-flow]` 的 DOM 变化，700ms 内有变动即为正在吐字；
- 「思考」= `[data-phase="active"]` 且本轮还没吐过字（`sawStream` 标记）；
- 「收尾」= 最后一条消息出现 `[data-slot*="turnTail"]` 或文本含「已完成/用时」，立刻回落空闲。

### 背景图层

```
#dsh-hud-root   position:fixed  z-index:0   pointer-events:none
├ .hud-plasma   径向渐变 + blur(70px)，26 秒漂移一轮
├ canvas        数字雨，30fps 上限，字符 01<>[]{}/\|+=*#%$@&
├ .hud-scan     扫描线（overlay 混合）
├ .hud-scrim    可读性暗层
└ .hud-vignette 暗角

#dsh-hud-fx     position:fixed  z-index:1   涟漪层（在界面之下）
```

整层是 `body` 的独立 fixed 图层，**不参与宿主布局**，因此不会产生列与列之间的接缝。

### 接管宿主底色

背景要透出来，必须清掉宿主的三层遮罩：

```css
body {
  --dsw-alias-bg-base:        rgba(6, 9, 13, .40) !important;
  --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2/3: rgba(..., .40) !important;
  --dsw-specific-sidebar-fill: rgba(6, 9, 13, .28) !important;
}
[class*="frame"], [class*="sidebarCol"], [class*="centerCol"], [class*="rightbarCol"] {
  background: transparent !important;
}
```

### 设置面板

侧栏 **HUD** → 强度滑杆（0–100）、六个分层开关、告警阈值、**预览区**。

预览区可以强制播放任意状态 6 秒，用来调参而不用真发消息：

```
[空闲 · 灰蓝] [打字 · 青] [思考 · 紫] [输出 · 橙] [告警 · 红]
```

点击后按钮本身会亮成对应颜色，下方显示「预览中：输出 · 橙（6 秒后自动恢复）」。

---

## 两者联动

余额插件每次成功拉取后写入：

```js
localStorage["dsh.balance.snapshot"] = { total: 40.53, at: 1732... }
```

HUD 每 250ms 读一次，低于阈值（默认 ¥10）就把整屏切成红色告警并让数据流加速。关闭方式：HUD 面板里取消勾选「余额联动」。

---

## 卸载

```powershell
$prof = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"

Remove-Item "$prof\node_modules\dsh-plugin-hud"     # junction
Remove-Item "$prof\plugins\dsh-plugin-hud" -Recurse

# 再从 package.json 的 dependencies 与 dsh.profile.bundles 里删掉对应两行
```

重启 DSH。余额插件的 Key 存在 `localStorage` 与 cookie 中，卸载后可手动清：

```js
localStorage.removeItem("dsh.balance.key");
localStorage.removeItem("dsh.balance.history");
localStorage.removeItem("dsh.balance.day.v2");
document.cookie = "dsh_balance_key=; path=/; max-age=0";
```

---

## 开发与验证

两个插件都是**单文件客户端插件**（`lib/client.js`），通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 注册。

```powershell
# 语法检查
node --check packages/hud/lib/client.js

# 桩环境验证：座位注册 + 组件渲染
node packages/hud/test-apply.cjs
node packages/balance/test-apply.cjs
```

### 插件结构

```
packages/hud/
├── package.json          dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml
├── cordis.patch.yml      往 profile 树里插入一条 entry
├── lib/index.js          host 半侧（no-op）
└── lib/client.js         浏览器半侧（全部实现）
```

### 调试技巧

- 改 `client.js` 后 **HMR 会自动生效**，不用重启；
- 但 `<style>` 只在首次注入，所以 CSS 必须写成「复用同一个 style 标签并重写 textContent」；
- 状态机不好猜时，先把判定条件做成面板上的开关或预览按钮，比反复发消息快得多。

---

# ds-bot

The DS Bot plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). It turns dsh into a team of long-lived Bots that talk to you, to each other and in group chats. See the [project page](../README.md) for an overview, install steps and screenshots.

Tested with dsh `0.2.2-rc.1` (Web and Desktop).

## Features

- **Long-lived Bots**: each Bot is a dsh Session in the "DS Bot" workspace, with its own name, role, instructions and model.
- **Working folders**: a Bot can work in a folder you choose instead of the team workspace, and a group chat can set one folder for all its members there. Pick it in the Bot's settings or details panel or in the group's settings, or ask a Bot (`update_bot`, `update_group`). After a change, the chat goes on in a fresh part that starts in the new folder. When a Bot sets a folder outside the team workspace, or adds a Bot to a group that works in one, it asks for your approval if those Bots can only write in their folder. Folders that hold dsh data (`$DSH_HOME`, the team's data) are refused. The team workspace itself moves in Settings > General > Locations; Bots and groups that work there go on in a fresh part in the new folder, and the old folder keeps its files.
- **Permission presets**: each Bot runs with its own dsh permission preset (Read only, Workspace or Full access), set in its details panel. A group chat can run all its members with one preset there, in place of their own: turn on **Same for every member** under Permissions in the group's settings. Only you set permissions; Bots cannot change them.
- **Bots work together**: `message_bot` sends a message to another Bot, `create_bot` and `update_bot` add and set up Bots (including a profile photo from a local image file or a data URL), and `ask_user` asks you a question without blocking the other Bots. `show_view` draws a card in a Bot's own chat — text, metrics, tables, charts, inputs with local formulas, progress, choices, confirmations, short forms and sandboxed HTML; an interactive card waits for your answer. `/side` (or **Side chat** in the panel's `···` menu) opens a side chat in the right panel that answers from a snapshot of the Bot's chat without running tools or interrupting its work. A Bot can also be marked **Private** in its settings: other Bots cannot read its working folder, memory or chat, and its outbound sharing needs your approval.
- **Group chats**: in admin-first mode the admin answers first and calls in other members with `@Name`; in all-members mode members speak in order. Members `@`-mentioned in the same message start work in parallel. Type `@` to pick a member from a list, or use **+ → Reference a chat** to attach another Bot's chat as context. A member with nothing new to add stays quiet (`[PASS]`). For multi-stage work, the admin can align on and run a group **Goal** (`group_goal`), assigning tasks per stage and checking evidence before advancing. Each member has its own hidden Session per group, so a group never reads a Bot's private chat.
- **Roles and permissions**:

  | Who | Can do |
  |---|---|
  | You | Everything |
  | Main Bot (there can be more than one) | Manage every group; change and delete Bots |
  | Group admin | Manage its own group only (name, notice, members, reply mode) |
  | Member | Speak in the group, `@` another member, and post into its groups from outside them |

- **Long chats stay inside the model's window**: dsh's own compaction never runs on a Bot's Session. When a turn ends past the check line (a share of the model's context window), a small separate model call, the context steward, reads the latest messages of the chat and decides once. If the work is still under way, the chat is condensed in place into a checkpoint: a handoff summary plus your recent messages word for word. If the work has reached a stopping point, the Bot writes a handoff note and continues in a new part. Either way you still see one chat, with no marker. Earlier parts and condensed messages stay searchable in a full-text index (`node:sqlite` FTS5) through `read_own_chat`.
- **Memory**: each Bot keeps notes across all its conversations, each group chat keeps its own for its members, and the team shares one more. See [Memory](#memory).
- **Web search**: see [Web search](#web-search).
- **Bot browser (dsh Desktop and the desktop app)**: see [Bot browser](#bot-browser).
- **Images**: for a model that cannot read images, a vision model first turns the image into text.
- **DeepSeek services**: an official API key can give any model independent OCR, DeepSeek TTS and DeepSeek dictation, each turned on explicitly in Settings → DeepSeek services. The key stays in Settings → Models. See [DeepSeek services](#deepseek-services).
- **Secrets**: a Bot asks for an API key or token with a card in its own chat and never sees the value. See [Secrets](#secrets).
- **Usage**: Settings → Usage shows token usage by time (24 hours to 12 months, or days picked on a calendar), by Bot and by model, with a page for each Bot and each model. Calls that a Session logs are read from the logs, so older chats count too. Calls that leave no log (checkpoints, handoff notes, the steward, image readings, dsh titles and compaction) are counted while they stream, from the time the plugin runs. Tokens only, no cost.
- **Make it yours**: name, role, instructions, model and look (20 characters and 12 colors, or your own photo from the reusable avatar library) for each Bot; a theme, an accent color, a message layout (bubble or flat) with width sliders, and an avatar animation level (quiet, normal or lively) for the team. A pinned Bot or group chat shows a small pushpin in the sidebar. Settings has these pages: General (look, default model for new Bots, Enter key preference, mode and locations), Models, Bots (Main Bots, each Bot's settings and retained private-Bot folders), Group chats (each group's settings), Connectors, Capabilities, DeepSeek services, Browser, Scheduled tasks, Usage, Secrets, Feedback and About DS Bot (versions, updates and links).

## Install

The [project page](../README.md#install) has the full steps for dsh Desktop and dsh Web. In short:

- dsh Desktop: Settings → Plugins → add `ds-bot` (npm), a `.tgz` file, or `github:Fei2411/DS-Bot#v<version>&path:/ds-bot`.
- Command line: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ds-bot` (or `--profile web`).

To work on the plugin from a checkout, add it to a dsh profile as a linked dependency and a bundle:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "ds-bot": "link:/path/to/ds-bot" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "ds-bot"] } }
}
```

Run `pnpm install` in the profile folder, then start dsh from the deepseek-harness repository:

```sh
pnpm -s dsh --profile web --no-open
```

The first time the team opens, the plugin creates a Main Bot called Chief.

**If DSH was upgraded and the Bot team does not start**: a profile can keep its own pinned copies of official DSH packages (for example `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` at the version before the upgrade). DSH then mounts the new installation's rows against those older modules, disables the rows whose versions do not match, and a plugin that injects their services — the Bot team's `sessionController` and `workspaceRegistry` — stays pending. This is a diagnostic/repair tool you run by hand — DS Bot never invokes it on its own. The doctor names the pins the running DSH does not satisfy; `--fix` removes only those (a version range the running DSH satisfies is kept, and only DSH runtime/bundle packages are considered), then runs `pnpm install` in the changed profile so a restart needs no separate manual install. If that install cannot run, it prints the exact command. Chats, settings and credentials are not touched:

```sh
npx ds-bot doctor
npx ds-bot doctor --fix
```

The doctor reads the profiles' `package.json` files only. If DSH still does not start after a clean report, an older copy may be a transitive dependency that another plugin brought into the profile; the report names `pnpm why @deepseek-ai/<package>` so you can find the plugin that carries it. The doctor never removes such a copy, because that would break the plugin that needs it.

**Upgrading from the legacy `dsh-bot` package**: earlier builds used the package name `dsh-bot`. Remove `dsh-bot` from the profile before you add `ds-bot`, because both use the plugin id `bot`. Your team, chats and secrets stay where they are (see [Data and backups](#data-and-backups)); saved browser settings, the theme and Bot colors move over the first time DS Bot opens.

## Configuration

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, under the `bot` entry. All of them are optional.

```yaml
- id: bot
  name: ds-bot
  config:
    workspace: /path/to/workspace   # where the Bots work; default <home>/workspace
    home: /path/to/bot-data         # where the team is saved; default $DSH_HOME/bot
    checkRatio: 0.8                 # share of the model's usable window where the steward decides
    checkTokens: 380000             # the highest context where it decides, even on a larger window
    browser: true                   # force the Bot browser on or off; default on in Desktop and the desktop app only
    memory: true                    # false turns memory off: no memory tools, section or panel
    memoryReview: true              # false leaves memory to the Bots' own bot_remember calls
    diagnosticsFile: false          # keep the error log in memory only; default <home>/logs/diagnostics.jsonl
    updateCheck: true               # look for a newer DS Bot when a window opens; default true
    updateRegistry: https://registry.example/   # ask only this npm registry for updates
    github: false                   # hide the GitHub connector; default shown in Connectors
```

**Updates**: when a window opens, DS Bot asks where it was installed from for a newer release: the npm registry (the one the DSH plugin manager installs from, then its fallbacks), or the latest GitHub release for a `github:…#vX.Y.Z` install. A newer version shows a cloud button at the top right of the sidebar; **Update** reinstalls DS Bot through the DSH plugin manager, and the new version runs from the next DSH start. A linked or local checkout is never offered an update. Settings → About DS Bot shows the same state, with **Check for updates** to ask again at once.

The same card can carry DSH itself: a DS Bot release may name the DSH release it was verified against (`dsBot.verifiedDsh` in its `package.json`), and only that version is offered — running something newer is a downgrade offer too. A release that names no version offers no DSH update. A DSH installed from npm is swapped by `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>`. DSH Desktop installs the newest release its own updater finds, so the card shows DSH there only when that release is the verified one, and **Open updates** opens the app's update panel. A release may raise the floor with `dsBot.minBot`: until the bot itself is that new, the DSH row waits.

## Models

Model providers are set up in DS Bot's **Settings → Models** (or the Main Bot's setup card) and stored through dsh's `llm-pi-ai` plugin in `cordis.patch.yml` and `.credentials.yaml`. Every Bot runs on one model of its own, from the models DSH serves. A new team's first Main Bot starts on a model card when more than one provider is ready or none is configured yet, and greets the user once a usable model is connected. **Settings → General → New Bots** can set a team default model for newly created Bots: the Create Bot form starts on that team default model when it is served and usable (otherwise the DSH default model, or the first usable model), and a Main Bot's `create_bot` without a named model uses the team default model before falling back to the creator's own model. The Bot's details panel and settings (or a Main Bot's `update_bot`) change a Bot's model; a Bot whose model is no longer served falls back to its last working model or shows the card again. A team saved by an older version keeps the model each Bot last ran on.

- Give every model a `contextWindow`. DS Bot takes its lines from it: the usable window is the window minus the reply reserve (`maxTokens`), the hard line is 95% of that, and the check line is `checkRatio` of it, capped at `checkTokens` (default 380,000) so a huge window does not keep one part past the point where a provider's prefix cache stops helping. A model without `contextWindow` gets the adapter's default (262,144 tokens for `llm-pi-ai`), which may be wrong for that model; a model that reports no window at all counts as 500,000.
- To send images, the provider needs `defaultInput: [ text, image ]`.
- Keep API keys out of the repository. Use dsh's own key storage or environment variables.

## DeepSeek services

Settings → DeepSeek services reports the state of the independent DeepSeek capabilities. `actions.deepseekServices()` returns `{ endpoint, key, ocr, tts, speech, preferences }` without any secret, and `setDeepseekServices({ ocr, tts, voice })` saves the three preferences (`ocr` on/off, `tts` `system|deepseek`, `voice` `stella|tide`). Omitted fields keep their value; `null` resets one. They live in `roster.prefs.deepseekServices`. The API key is set through the existing provider-key controls in Settings → Models (`actions.openModels()`); the page never reads or renders it, and shows the real ready/not-ready reason for each capability.

OCR is off by default: only after it is turned on in Settings → DeepSeek services do Bots get `read_document` and upload selected files (`path` or `attachment_id`) for text recognition. Local Office editing is unchanged, but `read_document` can also read Office files, so the page does not promise that Office files are never uploaded. It is read-only: `attachment_id` must name a file or image in the calling Session's own messages (a guessed id reads nothing), workspace paths follow that Session's working directory and privacy rules, and long results are filed so the full text stays readable (a private Bot's copy stays in its own folder, named with its Session id). TTS defaults to the system voice. Dictation is not a DS Bot preference: the host registers `deepseek-asr` with `speechToText`, and the page selects it through the existing speech Remote `configure({ providerId: 'deepseek-asr', language: 'auto' })`; when the Voice Input plugin is off the browser dictation path stays. A configured key alone enables nothing, and voice reads `roster.prefs.deepseekServices` for serial TTS with no new page layout.

Calls go to the official `https://api.deepseek.com` only and are billed to the user's own API key by usage. A gateway the DeepSeek route points at never receives (or provides) the key: when the route's credential happens to be named `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, DS Bot refuses rather than guess, and the status says why. See the [design note](../docs/plans/2026-11-14-deepseek-services.md) and `ds-bot/test/deepseek-services.test.js` (mock tests only, no network).

## Memory

A Bot remembers what should last beyond one conversation: your preferences, decisions, corrections and facts it should not ask again. Memory is plain Markdown in the [Agent Memory Repo](https://github.com/AgentMemoryRepo/agentmemoryrepo) format: one entry per line, ending in `[source: …; added: …]`.

After each turn, a memory review reads what is new in the conversation and keeps, updates or removes entries itself, so memory does not depend on the Bot deciding to call `bot_remember`. A Bot's own chat is reviewed by its model into its own memory; a group chat is reviewed once for the whole group, by the admin's model (or the first member's), into the group memory only. It keeps only what you say, writes entries in your language, and refuses keys, passwords and ID numbers.

- **Three scopes**: each Bot has its own memory; each group chat has a group memory, which its members read in that group only (not in their own chats, and not in other groups); and the team memory is read by every Bot. A Bot writes its own, and any member writes its group's memory from the group. Main Bots and group admins (of any group) also write the team memory; a Main Bot can read and change another Bot's memory when you ask.
- **Tools**: `bot_remember` saves an entry or replaces one (`replace`), `bot_forget` removes one, and `bot_recall` searches every entry, reads a topic whole, or lists what is saved. In a Bot's own chat they use its own memory by default; in a group chat, the group memory (`scope: "own"` for the Bot's own). The Bot adds the source (a part anchor such as `part 2 #1234`, which `read_own_chat` opens, or the group and the time) and the date; a Bot that writes for others is named with `by:`.
- **Files**: `MEMORY.md` holds what every conversation needs, and details go in topic files linked from its `## Index` as `[[topic]]`.
- **In the prompt**: the Bot's own and the team's `MEMORY.md` go into the Bot's system prompt, frozen for the conversation part; in a group Session the group's `MEMORY.md` goes in as a snapshot message at the start of the Session instead. What others change later comes as a short update message before the next step, and a turn can bring up matching topic entries as a message. Both leave the prompt as it was, so the provider's prefix cache holds.
- **Sizes**: only entry text counts. A `MEMORY.md` holds 12,000 characters in a group, 8,000 for a Bot and 4,000 for the team, changeable in Settings, and takes at most 2% of the model's usable window in the prompt. An entry has at most 300 characters and a topic 16,000. A save never fails for room: the oldest entries move to the topic `earlier`, and a full topic continues in a numbered one.
- **Team memory**: what every Bot always reads takes only what the user says, through `always` on `bot_remember` or the memory panel. Everything else written to the team waits in the topic `shared` for whoever needs it.
- **Entries**: each has a short id, an optional `until` after which it no longer shows, and a pin the user sets, which automatic changes leave alone.
- **Tidy**: once a day at most, a background pass merges repeats and archives what is over in each memory that changed, at most a fifth of its entries at a time. The memory panel shows each pass and undoes it whole.
- **Between Bots**: a Bot can read a public Bot's memory with `bot_recall`. Nothing of another Bot's reaches it unless it looks.
- **Safety**: memory is data, not instructions. An entry that looks like a key or token is refused, and a Bot is told not to save what a web page, file or tool result asks it to remember.
- **History**: files change in place, and `journal.jsonl` keeps every change with the line before and after (a private Bot keeps its own `journal.jsonl` in its folder). When a Bot or a group chat is deleted, its memory moves to `archive/`.

**The memory panel**: the details panel of a Bot, and of a group chat, has a Memory row with the entry count; Manage opens the memory panel. A Bot's panel shows its own memory and the team memory; a group's shows the group memory. Each entry can be moved to the team memory, another Bot, or a group chat; it keeps its end date and pin, and in the team memory it starts as "Only when needed".

- **Memory summary**: a model writes a short summary in prose from every entry, in the interface language: the Bot's, or for a group its admin's. It is written again when the entries change, and the ⋯ menu can regenerate it.
- **All entries**: the ⋯ menu lists every entry by scope and topic, with its date and author, and the size of each `MEMORY.md`. Remove takes two clicks.
- **Change history**: the ⋯ menu lists the changes recorded in `journal.jsonl` (newest first) and lets you undo an add, update or removal in two clicks while the entry still matches what that change left.
- **Ask or update**: ask what the Bot remembers, or tell it what to add, correct or remove. One model call answers from the entries only, and its changes go through the same checks as the tools.
- A line in the chat ("Memory updated") shows when a Bot changes memory and opens the panel. When memory changes in the background, the capsule at the top of the chat (the Bot's, or the group's) stretches to say "Memory updated" for a moment; clicking it opens the memory panel.

A read-only dsh (see [Data and backups](#data-and-backups)) shows memory but cannot change it.

## Web search

The package includes a second plugin, `ds-bot/web-search`. It registers the search provider `auto`, and `cordis.patch.yml` makes it the default. Each search goes in this order:

1. If the profile names another `searchProvider`, that one is used.
2. The current model route's own search, with that route's key and host. The plugin knows the Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses and Gemini protocols, and a few search APIs (DeepSeek, Ollama, Kimi, Zhipu, MiMo). A declared API runs only on an `https` base, since it carries the route's key. A provider's own long extract is kept as each source's `summary` beside the display snippet. Add more with `searchApis`.
3. A fallback without a key: the public result pages of Bing and DuckDuckGo.
4. If nothing works, the search fails and tells the model not to guess addresses.

Each result starts with a `Search backend: …` line that names the path it took.

**Turning `auto` off**: the `web` row still names `auto` when you turn off only the `web-search-auto` row (in the sidebar's Plugins page or with `disabled: true` in a profile patch). Then `web_search` fails in every session, Bot or not, with `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` (`configured web provider "auto" is not registered`). When you turn that row off, also name another `searchProvider` for the `web` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The override replaces the row's whole config, so restate `fetchProvider`:

```yaml
- id: web-search-auto
  name: ds-bot/web-search
  disabled: true
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official
    fetchProvider: http
```

Another plugin can also set the search provider while dsh runs, after the profile patch. When you turn such a plugin off, check this setting again.

## Bot browser

In dsh Desktop and the desktop app, each Bot has its own browser panel in the right column (open a page from the Bot's details panel or the panel bar's `···` menu).

- **One partition per Bot** (`bot:<id>`): logins and cookies belong to that Bot only. The desktop app keeps them on disk, so a Bot stays signed in after a restart; dsh Desktop keeps them in memory only.
- **The Bot can read the page**: the `read_browser` tool reads the page's DOM, not a screenshot. The text becomes Markdown with headings, nested lists, tables, code blocks and quotes. Links and form controls are marked `[#n]` in place and listed below with their targets and values. The tool also reads the text you selected. Long pages are read in parts (`from`). Page content is treated as data, never as instructions.
  - It reads open Shadow DOM (with `<slot>`) and same-origin iframes up to 3 levels deep.
  - It reads only what is visible: `display:none`, `visibility:hidden`, zero-height and closed `<details>` content is skipped.
  - It never reads the values of password, credit card (`autocomplete="cc-*"`) or one-time code fields.
  - Limits: 400,000 characters, 150,000 nodes, 5,000 rows per table, 3,000 links and controls, 1.5 seconds. A cut result says so.
  - It cannot read cross-origin iframes (one line with the address), closed shadow roots, canvas content (online editors, maps), or text in CSS `::before` / `::after`. On pages that render on demand, only the rendered part is read.
  - Without a browser plugin, `read_browser` is read-only. When a browser plugin (`refs`, `script` or `task`; see [`browser-plugins/`](../browser-plugins/)) is enabled in **Settings → Browser**, Bots can open, inspect and interact with pages in their own profile (`bot/browser-profiles/<botId>/`); in the desktop app they share the panel's tabs with you, hand off sign-in or payment steps via a chat card (`browser_handoff`), and yield whenever you take over.
- **Addresses**: http and https only. localhost and LAN addresses are allowed; cloud metadata addresses (such as `169.254.x.x`) and dsh's own ports are not.
- The browser panel and the details drawer share the right column; opening one closes the other. Switching chats switches the panel to that Bot. Deleting a Bot clears its browser and saved address.
- **Cookie import (desktop app only)**: the import button in the browser bar previews the cookies of a file (Cookie-Editor JSON, Netscape `cookies.txt`, Playwright `storageState`) or of an installed Chromium/Firefox profile, then writes them into the Bot's partition. A source browser closes for a moment so its cookie store can be copied, and it reopens with its tabs. Sign-in that lives outside cookies (localStorage, passkeys) does not come along.

dsh Web has no browser panel and no `read_browser` tool.

## Secrets

When a Bot needs an API key, token or password, it calls `request_secret`, and a secret card shows in its own chat. The Bot never sees the value.

- **Fill in**: the field hides what you type, is not part of a form and is not autofilled. Choose "All Bots" or "Only this Bot" and select Save. A value must have at least 4 characters (a 4-digit PIN works). A value of 8 characters or more is hidden wherever it appears; a shorter one only where no letter or digit touches it, so ordinary words stay intact.
- **Allow**: if the secret is already saved but this Bot is not allowed to use it, the card only asks whether to allow it. You can also replace the value there.
- **Use**: the value goes into the Bot's shell environment as `DSH_SECRET_<NAME>` (`$DSH_SECRET_NAME` in bash, `$env:DSH_SECRET_NAME` in PowerShell). `list_secrets` lists the names a Bot can use. An MCP capability can also take `$DSH_SECRET_<NAME>` in its env, its headers and its URL (path or query); in the URL the value is URL-encoded. Use headers when the server accepts them.
- **Masking**: before a tool result is saved and before each request goes to the model, every copy of a secret value is replaced with `[secret:<NAME>]`.
- **Manage**: Settings → Secrets lists every secret by name, purpose, the Bot that asked and the last use. You can change who may use it, replace the value, delete it or add one. Deleting a Bot removes it from every secret.
- **Storage**: `<DSH_HOME>/bot/secrets.json`, file mode 600, written atomically. Values are never in `state.json` or logs.
- **Encryption at rest (optional)**: Settings → Secrets → Encryption at rest turns the same file into a passphrase-locked envelope (scrypt key, AES-256-GCM payload). An unattended start unlocks it with `DS_BOT_SECRETS_PASSPHRASE` or with `DS_BOT_SECRETS_PASSPHRASE_FILE` (a file with the passphrase); without either the store starts locked, the Secrets page says how to unlock it, and secret writes are refused. Plaintext stays the default and existing files need no migration.

Limits:

- On Windows, the file mode has no effect; the file is protected by your user folder only.
- Only exact copies of a value are masked. A Bot that encodes, splits or reverses a value can still print it. Do not give important secrets to a Bot you do not trust.
- On a page that is not HTTPS (for example dsh Web opened over http on a LAN), the value crosses the network in clear text. The card warns you.
- Group chats show no cards; a Bot asks in its own chat.

## Data and backups

The plugin saves its data in `config.home`. Without it, the folder is `$DSH_HOME/bot`, or `~/.dsh/bot` when `DSH_HOME` is not set.

| System | Default folder |
|---|---|
| Linux, macOS | `~/.dsh/bot/` |
| Windows | `C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\bot\` |

- To move all dsh data (Sessions, profiles and plugin data), set `DSH_HOME`.
- To move only the plugin data, set `home` in the configuration (see [Configuration](#configuration)).

Files in `bot/`:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `state.json` | The team: Bots, groups, Bot-to-Bot messages, preferences and open questions. A long message keeps only its first 2,000 characters here; all of it is in the Session it went to. |
| `ledger/` | Everything said in each group, whole, one append-only file per group (`group-<id>.jsonl`); removed with the group. `state.json` keeps only a group's latest 60 lines, cut to their start |
| `handoff-results/` | The whole result of a piece of work a Bot handed on, when it is longer than the 2,000 characters `state.json` keeps, one file per result; each is removed once the answer it went into has gone up |
| `state.lock` | The dsh that is using this data (pid and host), its mtime bumped as a heartbeat. It is removed when that dsh exits; a leftover whose heartbeat has stopped is taken over by the next dsh to load. |
| `chat-index.sqlite` | Full-text index of older chat parts (`read_own_chat`); rebuilt if deleted |
| `usage.sqlite` | Token counts for the Usage page; rebuilt from the Session logs if deleted, losing only the calls outside the logs and the names of deleted Bots |
| `memory/` | Memory (see [Memory](#memory)): `bots/<id>/`, `groups/<id>/` and `team/` (`MEMORY.md` and topics), `journal.jsonl` (every change), `snapshots/` (the section each Session froze), `summaries/` (the panel's summary; safe to delete), `reviewed.json` (how far the memory review has read) and `archive/` (deleted Bots and group chats) |
| `ocr.json` | Cache of image text; safe to delete |
| `avatars/` | The avatar library: the profile photos you imported once, so several Bots can use the same picture. `index.json` lists them, `files/` holds the images, each named by the hash of its bytes, so the same photo is stored once. The Bots that use a photo keep their own copy. Safe to delete. |
| `workspace` | The team workspace: the working folder of every Bot without one of its own (`config.workspace` changes it) |

# dsh-prompt-predict
Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness
After each reply, your next prompt is ghosted right into the composer — Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss, start typing and it's gone

🌏 中文 · English
`dsh-prompt-predict` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/) plugin: after every assistant turn it predicts **the message you are most likely to type next** and floats it into the composer as gray ghost text. The suggestion never enters the editor — only pressing `Tab` inserts it, and even then it stays undoable — so a wrong prediction costs you nothing. ## 📑 Table of Contents - [✨ Features](#-features) - [🚀 Installation](#-installation) - [⌨️ Usage](#-usage) - [⚙️ Settings](#-settings) - [🔌 HTTP API](#-http-api) - [🧩 How it works](#-how-it-works) - [🛠️ Development](#-development) - [🔐 Security and cost](#-security-and-cost) - [🩺 Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting) - [⚠️ Known limitations](#-known-limitations) - [📄 License](#-license) ## ✨ Features - **Single-line or multi-line** — sentences stay one line; code snippets, lists and multi-paragraph replies keep their line breaks and indentation - **A suggestion the moment a reply ends** — gray ghost text rendered at the composer's first character, matching the editor's caret position, font size and line height - **Three interactions** — `Tab` to accept, `↻` (or `↓`) for a different suggestion, `Esc` to dismiss; typing hides it, and clearing the draft brings it back - **Lightweight context** — only the most recent user/assistant *text*; tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave your machine - **Follows the current session model by default** — nothing is hard-coded to a provider, the prediction call reuses whatever model the session itself uses; you can also pin a cheaper model - **No repeats, no dead ends** — a repeat of the previous suggestion triggers an automatic "give me a different one"; a reasoning level the real model doesn't support falls back automatically, so you never hit "settings look fine but no suggestion ever appears" - **Everything is adjustable** — on/off, provider / model, response timeout, context size and budget, output cap, reasoning effort; changes apply immediately, no DSH restart - **Light and dark** — the ghost text, settings page and history follow the system/app colour scheme (`prefers-color-scheme`), with contrast kept at WCAG AA in both - **The UI follows your language** — the plugin ships dictionaries for the languages DSH itself supports (Chinese and English), and passes every dictionary it has to the locale service. Switch Settings → Language and the whole plugin UI changes at once, including the ghost hint above the composer **and the validation errors inside Settings** (those are produced by the host, which answers in the language the client sends); no reload needed, and it falls back to Chinese when no locale service is present - **Zero runtime dependencies** — plain ESM on both the host and client side ## 🚀 Installation The plugin is published on npm. Options are ordered by convenience. ### Install inside DSH (recommended) **GUI**: open the plugins page → **Add plugin** → enter the package name `dsh-prompt-predict` → install. **Or the dsh CLI** — pin any published version with pnpm's `@version` syntax: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-prompt-predict@0.2.22 ``` Replace `--profile` with your own profile (usually `desktop` on the desktop app, `web` for the web build), then **restart DSH**. **Upgrade to the latest release** ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-prompt-predict@latest ``` From a source checkout, `bash scripts/update.sh [profile]` does the same and also converges the lockfile; it refuses to run while the app is still up — quit it first. The settings page has a **Check for updates** button next to the version and also checks npm automatically when opened (at most once every 10 minutes). When a newer version exists it links straight to **DSH sidebar → Plugins → Installed plugins → dsh-prompt-predict → Versions → Update**, where DSH handles the download, rollback and restart; a copyable CLI command remains as a fallback. Update notices live only in Settings — there is no banner under the composer. > ⚠️ **The CLI only installs the package.** DSH loads a plugin only when it is also listed in > `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`. Verified: with the package > installed but not in that list, the plugin's routes answer `404` and nothing loads. The GUI route > above handles it for you; with the CLI add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to that array yourself, or just > run `scripts/install.sh` below, which does both steps. > You'll find the switch and all parameters under **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**. ### Install from a release tarball Every [release](https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict/releases) carries the exact tarball that is on npm (`shasum` matches the registry), which is handy for offline machines or for pinning an artifact you can verify: ```bash gh release download v0.2.22 --repo ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict --pattern '*.tgz' dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-prompt-predict-0.2.22.tgz ``` Same caveat as the CLI route above: add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` yourself, or run `scripts/install.sh` instead. ### Install from source ```bash git clone https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict.git cd dsh-prompt-predict bash scripts/install.sh # make sure the app is fully quit first (Cmd+Q) — the script refuses to run while it is up ``` The script packs this repo on the fly, installs it into the profile's `node_modules`, and adds `dsh-prompt-predict` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The default target is `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`; for another profile: ```bash bash scripts/install.sh ~/.dsh/profiles/web ``` **Restart DSH afterwards**, then look under **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**. ### Manual install ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-prompt-predict # from npm # or link local source (symlink — handy while developing): pnpm add /path/to/dsh-prompt-predict ``` Then open that profile's `package.json` and add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array, and restart DSH. ### Requirements - Verified on **DSH `0.2.2-rc.5`** (web build; the desktop app runs the same host and client code) - `node` / `pnpm`: the install script prefers DSH's own runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependencies` and only falls back to `PATH` - macOS / Linux; Windows untested ## ⌨️ Usage 1. Chat normally, wait for the assistant to finish its turn, and leave the **composer empty** 2. About 350 ms later a gray suggestion appears, with controls and shortcut hints on its right by default 3. Pick what you need: | Action | Effect | |---|---| | `Tab` | Accept the whole thing while the composer is focused (only now is it inserted, and it stays undoable) | | `↻` (button on the right) | **Reroll** — ask the model for a different suggestion | | `↓` | Generate the next suggestion (counts toward *Max switches*); if this round already has later suggestions, move forward through them for free. With no suggestion showing and an empty composer it fetches one immediately. `Ctrl/⌘+↓` works as a fallback | | `↑` | Return to the previous suggestion in this round (free) | | `Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Space` | Trigger a prediction by hand; rerolls when one is already showing | | `Esc` | Dismiss this one | | Just start typing | It disappears; **clearing the draft brings it back** (only `Esc` is a permanent dismissal) | Suggestions only appear when the composer is empty and the session isn't running. Switching sessions or interrupting a reply clears any pending suggestion. ## ⚙️ Settings **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**: | Setting | Description | Default | |---|---|---| | Enable predictions | Master switch | On | | Provider / model | Model used for the prediction call; pick "Follow current session model" to reuse the session's own model | Follow current session model | | Response timeout (advanced) | 1–60 seconds | 12 seconds | | Context size (advanced) | Small 3 / Standard 8 / Large 12 messages | Standard 8 | | Context budget (advanced) | Character cap sent to the helper call, 1000–20000 | 6000 | | Output length | How long a suggestion should be, in **characters** (20–400) — no token maths. Pinning a Latin-script language also shows the equivalent in words; CJK stays in characters because word segmentation is undefined there. The host derives a generous token safety cap from it (per language) and writes the character budget into the prompt; a reply that still gets cut is retried with more room and marked **cut off · raise the output length** | 120 | | Keep multi-line formatting | Allow code snippets/lists to keep line breaks and indentation (off = always one line) | On | | Minimal display | Hide the `Tab` and `↻` buttons and the arrow-key and `Esc` hints next to the ghost text on desktops with a hover-capable fine primary pointer and no coarse pointer. Touch and mixed-input devices keep the usual display and tappable controls. Keyboard shortcuts and status notices are unchanged | Off | | Switchable suggestions | When on, ↓ generates the next suggestion and ↑ returns to the previous one (kept in this round's history); off disables arrow switching and the ↻ button | On | | Max switches | Max new suggestions generated per round (0–10; `0` = unlimited). Moving back with ↑ does not count | 3 | | Reasoning effort (advanced) | Options are **generated from the model actually in use** (the session's model when following it); unsupported levels never appear | Off (fastest, cheapest) | | Suggestion language | `Auto` follows the conversation; pin a language and every suggestion is written in it. 14 mainstream languages are listed up front, the rest fold behind **More languages…**, and languages with regional variants get a second **Region** dropdown: Simplified Chinese (Mainland China / Singapore / Malaysia), Traditional Chinese (Taiwan / Hong Kong), English (US / UK / Australia / Canada), Portuguese (Brazil / Portugal), Spanish (Spain / Latin America (neutral) / Mexico / Argentina / Colombia), French (France / Canada), German (Germany / Austria / Switzerland), Dutch (Netherlands / Belgium). The chosen variant is named explicitly in the prompt (e.g. *Traditional Chinese (Taiwan)*, *British English*) | Auto | | Pause | Stops predictions for ten minutes with a countdown, then resumes automatically; the deadline survives a reload | Off | | History size (advanced) | How many recent predictions the settings page keeps (0–50; `0` turns history off). Records live in the app's own local storage — the Electron renderer's storage in the desktop app, the page's `localStorage` on web — and are never uploaded | 10 | The bottom of the settings page shows a **recent predictions** list (default 10, adjustable): time, session, model, latency, and whether the reasoning level was auto-downgraded, a reroll happened, the suggestion was truncated by the output cap, or the call failed (with the reason). The list stays folded to the newest run (`▸ Show all` opens the rest), the newest run's suggestion text is expanded by default, and clicking a row's `▸` expands that run's text while collapsing the previous one. Records live in the app's own local storage (the Electron renderer's storage on desktop, the page's `localStorage` on web) and are never uploaded. No more guessing why nothing appeared. - Click **Save** to apply changes immediately — no DSH restart - Settings are stored at `~/.dsh/dsh-prompt-predict/config.json` (mode 600) - Precedence: **user-saved settings > cordis patch deploy defaults > built-in defaults** ## 🔌 HTTP API The plugin registers a same-origin prefix route `/dsh-prompt-predict` on DSH's web server; both the settings page and the composer suggestion go through it. Every endpoint is authenticated with DSH's browser cookie (`connection.requestRejection`) — off-machine callers get 401/403. | Method | Path | Description | |---|---|---| | GET | `/dsh-prompt-predict/status` | Current session model, effective settings, saved overrides, deploy defaults | | GET | `/dsh-prompt-predict/catalog` | All providers and models (for the dropdowns) | | GET | `/dsh-prompt-predict/efforts?provider=&model=` | The reasoning levels that model actually supports | | POST | `/dsh-prompt-predict/settings` | Save settings; `{ "reset": true }` restores defaults | | POST | `/dsh-prompt-predict/suggest` | `{ sessionId }` → one suggestion | Every endpoint accepts an optional **`x-dsh-locale`** header (`zh` / `en`, default Chinese) deciding which language validation errors and prediction failures come back in. The client sends the active UI language automatically. ## 🧩 How it works **Host side** (`lib/`) 1. `lib/index.js` is the plugin entry point and registers the same-origin HTTP route 2. On `suggest`, `lib/predict.mjs` trims the session down to the most recent user/assistant plain text — walking backwards under both a message-count limit and a character budget 3. That trimmed history is **framed as a single request-only user input** before it reaches the helper model: DSH assistant messages must carry a full `stream` / `replayState`, so a trimmed fragment cannot masquerade as one (same approach session-title uses) 4. The streamed reply is normalized (code fences, `Suggestion:` prefixes and wrapping quotes stripped, newlines collapsed) and returned to the client For model selection, `provider` / `model` set to `auto` means "follow the session": no route is hard-coded onto the helper call, and `predictNextPrompt` inherits whatever the session itself selected. **Client side** (`client/`) - Injects into the `conversation.composer.dock` (lifecycle mount point next to the composer) and `settings.section` slots - The ghost text is an **overlay** — it is never written into the Lexical editor; only accepting goes through `inputActions.insertText` ### Client source layout The client is built from ordered fragments in `client/src/` (`npm run build:client` writes `client/client.js`). DSH loads exactly one client script, so the split is a source-organisation aid, not native ES modules; `pretest` and `prepack` rebuild automatically. ### Real-DSH smoke test (macOS, optional) `npm run test:smoke` boots a disposable DSH profile, installs this repo as a local tarball, starts a local mock LLM and drives a headless Edge via CDP. It covers ghost display, focus-scoped Tab acceptance, reroll, ↓/↑ switching, pause, multi-line code, and a geometry matrix for narrow/scaled composers (260/220/180/600 px, `scale(0.8/1.25/1.5)`, and a decoy composer). Requires the DeepSeek Harness app and Microsoft Edge; override paths with `DSH_SMOKE_DSH` and `DSH_SMOKE_EDGE`. It is deliberately not part of `npm test`. `npm run test:sidebar` is a separate opt-in probe for the real right sidebar. It additionally installs `dsh-better-sidebar@0.30.1`, opens **Plugins → side chat**, creates a thread, sends a message, and prints the real DOM. Current finding: that version's side chat uses `TEXTAREA._4BEzFa_sidechatComposerInput` and does not mount the plugin composer dock, so it produces zero plugin ghosts; the probe is diagnostic and makes no right-sidebar ghost assertion. See [test/README.md](test/README.md) for the full test matrix and the issue #6 investigation notes. ## 🛠️ Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict.git cd dsh-prompt-predict npm test # 151 host-side + 247 client render cases ``` ``` . ├── lib/ Host side (plain ESM, no build step) │ ├── index.js Plugin entry point, registers the HTTP route │ ├── host-route.mjs Same-origin API: status / catalog / efforts / settings / suggest │ ├── predict.mjs Session trimming, helper-model call, suggestion normalization │ ├── messages.mjs User-facing host copy (Chinese + English) │ └── config.mjs User settings persistence ├── client/ │ └── client.js Client: composer ghost-text overlay + settings page ├── test/ │ ├── predict.mjs 151 cases: trimming, cleanup, route inheritance, settings validation, degrade-retry, dedup, bilingual errors, HTTP end-to-end │ ├── client-render.mjs 247 cases: ghost/settings rendering through a tiny React stand-in, Tab focus matrix, geometry, IME/paste/attachments, both locales │ ├── dsh-smoke.mjs 18 real-DSH checks (optional; also hosts the opt-in sidebar probe) │ └── README.md test matrix, real-DSH smoke and right-sidebar probe notes ├── scripts/ │ ├── install.sh One-shot install from a local pack │ └── update.sh Upgrade a profile to the npm latest ├── cordis.patch.yml Plugin mount patch └── package.json ``` > `test/client-render.mjs` is the only automated safety net for the client side: no browser needed — a tiny React stand-in expands the components into a plain object tree so the test can assert that the ghost shows up and that `Tab` / `↻` / `Esc` are all there. It exists because of a real incident: the overlay referenced a variable it never read from props, the render threw, React's error boundary swallowed it, and the symptom was "the API returns a suggestion but nothing ever appears" — while every host-side test was green. The tests need no DSH runtime: a fake ctx plus a local HTTP server cover route registration, settings validation, route inheritance and end-to-end calls. ## 🔐 Security and cost - **One** small helper call per assistant turn by default; an extra attempt only happens when the reply hits the length limit, the reasoning level needs downgrading, or a suggestion needs rerolling — **four calls is the hard ceiling** (primary, reasoning-level fallback, length retry, reroll), and they share a single timeout budget - Suggestions are **not written to the session log**; only after you accept with `Tab` and send does the text become a real message - Only trimmed user/assistant plain text is sent — tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave the machine - Both the settings page and the suggestion endpoint sit behind DSH's own browser-cookie authentication ## 🩺 Troubleshooting **No suggestion appears at all** - It runs only after an assistant turn ends (about 350 ms later), never while the reply is still streaming. - The composer must be empty. If you already have a draft, the prediction is skipped on purpose — no call is made. - A brand-new session with no messages has nothing to predict from. - Check Settings → Prompt suggestions: *Enable predictions* must be on, the session must not be paused, and **Recent predictions** must not show an error. **"Prediction failed: …" shows under the composer** (it appears after two failures in a row) | Reason text | What to do | |---|---| | `Request timed out` | Raise *Response timeout* in Advanced | | `Provider "…" is unavailable` / `has no model "…"` | Pin a provider and model instead of following the session model | | `Prompt prediction is turned off` | Turn the switch back on | | anything else | Open Settings → Prompt suggestions → **Recent predictions**; the row carries the host's exact reason | **Suggestions come in the wrong language** - `Auto` (the default) detects the language from your recent messages by majority vote over the last five, so a message that is mostly a pasted log can skew it. - Pin one instead: Settings → *Suggestion language* (with a *Region* picker for Chinese, English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Dutch). - The UI language does **not** affect the suggestion language — those are two separate settings. **A suggestion ends with "cut off · raise the output length"** - Raise *Output length*. A capped reply is already retried once with more room before the marker appears. - Reasoning models can spend a large part of the budget before writing any text; if this happens often, raise the length or keep *Reasoning effort* off (the default). **Tab does nothing** - `Tab` is intercepted only while a suggestion is visible; with no ghost it behaves normally. - Click into the composer first — the overlay is positioned over the editor's caret box, and `Tab` acts on the focused editor. **Ghost text sits on top of what I typed** - Fixed in `0.2.7`: it hides on paste, IME composition and drag-and-drop, and it no longer appears while the composer has a draft. Upgrade if you still see this. **"Recent predictions" is empty** - Records are local to the app's own storage, are wiped by the *Clear* button, and runs recorded before `0.2.5` carry no suggestion text. **I upgraded but nothing changed** - Host-side changes (settings fields, prompt construction) apply after **restarting the app**; client-side changes apply after **reloading the window**. The version label in `package.json` is not rewritten by a window reload. ## ⚠️ Known limitations - Verified only on DSH `0.2.2-rc.5`; other versions untested - Depends on the host's `conversation.composer.dock` and `settings.section` slot names — a major DSH update may require adapting - Predictions consume quota on the selected model; pinning a fast small model is cheaper than following a reasoning model ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE) © ferrisching Free to use, modify and distribute, including in closed-source commercial projects — just keep the copyright notice and license text. See [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) for the change history ([中文](./CHANGELOG_zh.md)).

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. MIT and exact npm gitHead align with committed host/client entries and the README DSH 0.2.2-rc.5 baseline. Prediction routes fail closed when connection.requestRejection is missing or rejects; predictions use session/model context and require user acceptance into the composer. The prepack client build was read, not run. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# GUI（桌面与窗口控制） > 作者：赢容 · MIT · 与「WPS 多面手」（`dsh-multitool`）同一位作者 DSH 的图形层：用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 起一个 stdio MCP 服务器 `windows-mcp`，把 Windows 的 UI Automation 和窗口管理包装成一组工具，模型就能像人一样看屏幕、点按钮、敲键盘、切换窗口、管理虚拟桌面。 工具名形如 `mcp__gui__<工具名>`（`serverName: gui`，共 15 个），另带一份技能 `gui-desktop` 教模型按顺序使用。 ## 装 ```powershell # 本目录已经是完整 bundle，DSH 里走「插件 → 添加插件 → 本地目录」 # 或者 plugin_manager install_bundle，target 指到本目录的绝对路径 ``` 包名 `dsh-gui-forkgo`（无 scope，与「WPS 多面手」`dsh-multitool` 同一个风格）。 改名轨迹：`@local/windows-mcp` → `@local/gui` → **`dsh-gui-forkgo`**，旧包名都已不存在。 `suffix forkgo` 是为了避开 npm 上已被预留的 `dsh-gui`（作者 Caxson，占名不发布）。 ## 提供什么 服务器名固定为 `gui`，21 个上游工具加 1 个本地新增的 `VirtualDesktop`： | 能力 | 工具 | |---|---| | 观察 | `Snapshot`、`Screenshot`、`DisplayInventory` | | 鼠标 | `Click`、`Move`、`Scroll`、`MultiSelect` | | 键盘 | `Type`、`Shortcut`、`MultiEdit` | | 窗口与程序 | `App`、`Process`、`Wait`、`WaitFor` | | 文件与系统 | `FileSystem`、`Registry`、`PowerShell`、`Clipboard`、`Scrape`、`Notification` | | 控制权 | `ControlStatus` | | 虚拟桌面 | `VirtualDesktop`（任务栏上那几组窗口：列出、新建、切换、重命名、删除、把窗口挪过去） | 和内置 `pwsh` 工具的分工：`pwsh` 是命令行层（改文件、跑脚本、抓日志），GUI 是图形层（点安装向导、读弹窗、处理只有 GUI 才有的流程）。 ## 依赖 - `uvx` 在 PATH 上（本机：`%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\uvx.exe`） - 依赖由 uvx 从 PyPI 装（`windows-mcp` 要求 Python `>=3.14`：pywin32、comtypes、dxcam 等） ## 本地分支怎么接的 **包本体来自包内 vendor 的源码，依赖仍来自 PyPI。** ```yaml args: ['--python','3.14','--from','windows-mcp','windows-mcp','serve','--transport','stdio'] env: PYTHONPATH: <本包位置>/vendor/windows-mcp # !!js 反解，不写死 ``` 不用 `--from <本地目录>`：uvx 对本地目录的构建缓存不看文件 mtime，改完源码它照样复用上一次构建的产物。实测把整个文案改成中文之后跑起来还是旧文案，而且没有任何提示。`PYTHONPATH` 让源码直接生效，改一行就是一行。 代价是那个目录必须是**全量源码树**（完整的 `windows_mcp/` 包），不能是只放改动文件的覆盖层。PYTHONPATH 一旦命中，同名子模块全部从这里取，缺文件就是 ImportError。 路径由 `!!js` 从本包位置反解，不写死绝对路径。写死的话别人 clone 下来装，那个目录不存在，而 dsh 不会报错——它静默落回 PyPI 上游，于是 VirtualDesktop 消失、屏幕提示变回英文。 源码里的改动与实测边界见 `vendor/windows-mcp/README.local.md`。 ## 改 - 换服务器网关名：`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `serverName`（工具前缀随之变化，规则 `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`） - 退回纯上游：删掉 `PYTHONPATH` 那段即可（15 个工具会退回 21 个，`VirtualDesktop` 与 `IsolatedSession` 消失） - 命令跑得慢：调 `toolCallTimeoutMs` / `startupTimeoutMs` - 不想自动重连：`reconnect.enabled: false` 改完在插件页重新启用 `include:gui` 即可热加载。 ## 自检 改完先跑一遍，不需要 dsh： ```powershell node selftest.js # 结构 + 技能 + 连接层（会真起一次 MCP，约 5 秒） node selftest.js --no-connect # 只验结构与技能 ``` 验的是三件「改对了也看不出来」的事： 1. **包结构** —— `dsh.bundle.patch`、`exports['./package.json']`、`args` 里没有相对路径、 `PYTHONPATH` 指向的是完整源码树而不是增量覆盖层。 2. **技能 frontmatter** —— `name` 是 kebab-case 且与目录名一致、`description` 不为空。 缺 description 时 dsh 会静默不加载，用户只看到「AI 不会用」，没有任何报错。 3. **连接层** —— 真起 stdio、`initialize`、`tools/list`，确认 15 个工具里 `VirtualDesktop` 与 `IsolatedSession` 都在（本地分支生效）、工具名不重复、 屏幕提示文案是中文、名字合 dsh 字符集。 ## 提交 本目录是独立 git 仓库，署名与「WPS 多面手」一致： ```powershell git config user.name "赢容" git config user.email "yingrong@local" ``` 提交信息用 `feat:` / `fix:` / `chore:` + 中文描述，`——` 分隔动作与理由。 # GUI · DSH 的图形层 **简体中文** [![CI](https://github.com/forkgo430/dsh-gui-forkgo/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/forkgo430/dsh-gui-forkgo/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-15-brightgreen.svg)](#提供什么) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-lightgrey.svg)](#环境要求) 让 AI 操作 Windows 界面：截屏观察、点击、输入、快捷键、窗口与进程、虚拟桌面。 改文件、跑脚本这类事用 `pwsh` 更快。GUI 针对的是命令行碰不到的流程：安装向导、 登录弹窗、没有 CLI 的老软件、要拖拽才能完成的界面。 作者：**赢容** · 与 [WPS 多面手](https://github.com/forkgo430/wps-multitool-mcp) 同一作者 ## 30 秒上手 三种装法，选一个： ```powershell # ① 从 npm（最省事，但版本可能落后于源码） npm i dsh-gui-forkgo # ② 本地目录（改源码立即生效，开发用这个） # 插件页 → 添加插件 → 本地目录 → 选本仓的 dsh-bundle/ plugin_manager install_bundle，target 指到 dsh-bundle/ 的绝对路径 # ③ GitHub Release 的 tgz npm i https://github.com/forkgo430/dsh-gui-forkgo/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-gui-forkgo-1.2.0.tgz ``` > **⚠ npm 上的版本和源码不同步。** > npm 是 `1.2.2`（2026-11-21 审核通过），本地源码也是 `1.2.2`，但**内容不一样**： > 本地多了 `agent_idle_release_seconds`（智能体长时间不动作就自动交还控制权）。 > 版本号相同是历史遗留，不是笔误。要完整功能请用**本地目录**装法。 装完重启插件行，可以直接说： > 帮我看看屏幕上现在是什么 > 点一下那个"下一步" > 把记事本里那段文字复制出来 其他例子： - "等安装向导出现，一路点下一步" - "在浏览器的地址栏输入 xxx 然后回车" - "把这两个窗口分到两个虚拟桌面上" ## 提供什么 服务器名是 `gui`，工具名形如 `mcp__gui__<工具名>`，共 15 个： | 能力 | 工具 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | 观察 | `Snapshot` · `Screenshot` · `DisplayInventory` | 控件树带可点坐标；`use_vision=False` 时只返回文本，不附图 | | 输入 | `Input` | 一个入口。`action` 分发：click / type / scroll / move / shortcut / wait / wait_for / multi_select / multi_edit | | 窗口与程序 | `App` · `Process` | 启动、切换、调整窗口、查进程 | | 文件与系统 | `FileSystem` · `Registry` · `PowerShell` · `Clipboard` · `Scrape` · `Notification` | | | 控制权 | `ControlStatus` | 谁在控制、空闲多久交还、截图缓存的运行状态 | | **虚拟桌面** | **`VirtualDesktop`** | 任务栏那几组窗口：列出、新建、切换、重命名、删除、搬窗口 | | **隔离会话** | **`IsolatedSession`** | 独立子会话：AI 在另一个桌面里操作，不抢你的鼠标键盘。`status` 查能力、`setup` 存密码一次、`start`/`stop` 起停常驻宿主、`inject` 注入 DLL、`forget` 删凭据 | 另有一份技能 `gui-desktop`，说明这些工具的使用顺序。 输入类工具原本是七个（`Click`、`Type`、`Scroll`、`Move`、`Shortcut`、`Wait`、 `WaitFor`），加上 `MultiSelect`、`MultiEdit` 一共九个。1.2.0 把它们合并成 `Input` 一个入口，实现函数没有改动，只是外面套了一层按 `action` 分发的壳。 ### 四处实现上的取舍 **`Snapshot` 默认不附图。** 只返回控件树，含角色、名称、坐标、可用动作、快捷键。 坐标可以直接用来点击。canvas、WebGL 和图片里的文字不在控件树里，这些情况才需要开 `use_vision`。 **`VirtualDesktop` 是本仓加的。** 上游 `windows-mcp` 写好了虚拟桌面的 COM 封装， 只用来过滤窗口列表，21 个工具里没有一个暴露它。这里挂成工具，并改掉上游封装 三处会让工具报假成功的地方。 **屏幕提示是中文的。** 接管桌面时四周有蓝光、顶部中间一块提示，接管前还有确认框： ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │ AI 正在控制这台电脑 │ │ 大幅移动鼠标 │ │ 或按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Backspace 接管 │ └─────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` 接管方式有两种：大幅移动鼠标，或按 `Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Backspace`。 面板在 1920 宽的屏上约 424×118，占屏幕 22%×11%；窄屏自动缩小。 字体用的是等线（`Dengb.ttf` 28px / `Deng.ttf` 19px），不是微软雅黑。 在本机 412 个字体里挑了几套渲染同一段中文做对比：雅黑的中文笔画在小字号下 发软，黑体太硬，等线的中英混排最干净。面板不透明度也从 0.80 提到 0.88—— 原来的透明度会让白字透出背景色，笔画边缘发灰。 **`IsolatedSession` 也是本仓加的（1.2.0）。** 它解决的是「AI 抢鼠标键盘」这个具体问题。做法是在同一台机器上开一个**子会话** （Windows 的 Child Session），AI 在那个桌面里操作，你的桌面完全不受影响。 要一次 Windows 密码：首次 `setup` 会弹系统标准凭据框，密码用当前账户的 DPAPI 加密后存进凭据管理器 `dsh-gui/Session`，之后不再问。存的是**标准 DPAPI blob**， 不是自定义方案。 三点已知约束，先说在前面： - **子会话的存活绑在 RDP 宿主进程上**，宿主一退会话就掉线。`start` 动作会起一个 独立的宿主进程（窗口挪到屏幕外，用户看不见），插件重载不影响它。 - 一个系统同一时刻只能有一个活动子会话。 - **能用 UIA 控件模式做的事本来就不动真实指针**，那些场景不需要子会话。 子会话只解决 canvas、自绘界面这类 UIA 覆盖不到的情况。 用法四步： ``` IsolatedSession(action="setup") → 弹一次凭据框，存下来 IsolatedSession(action="start") → 起宿主建会话，约 5 秒就绪 IsolatedSession(action="status") → 确认 state=active、explorer 在 IsolatedSession(action="stop") → 收工，子会话销毁 ``` 调查与实测的完整记录（含微软文档没写的那条例外、注入链路验证、账户锁定的教训） 在 [`docs/虚拟桌面计划.md`](docs/虚拟桌面计划.md)。 ## 环境要求 | 要求 | 说明 | |------|------| | Windows 10 / 11 | UI Automation 与虚拟桌面 API 只在 Windows 可用 | | DSH | 需要插件系统与 MCP 客户端（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`） | | [`uvx`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) 在 PATH 上 | 首次启动会拉 Python 3.14 与 pywin32、comtypes、dxcam | ## 它怎么工作 ```mermaid flowchart LR A["DSH
loader"] -->|按包名解析| B["dsh-bundle
只有配置与资产"] B -->|spawn| C["uvx"] C -->|拉依赖 + PYTHONPATH 覆盖源码| D["windows-mcp
stdio MCP server"] D -->|15 个工具| A B -->|customSkillDirs| E["gui-desktop
SKILL.md"] E --> A ``` bundle 里没有可执行代码，只有配置和资产。实际执行的是 `uvx` 拉起的 `windows-mcp` 子进程。 ## 边界 **虚拟桌面不隔离输入。** 切换之后鼠标键盘仍然共享，被切走的桌面里进程照常运行、 照常出声。要真正隔离得用 `IsolatedSession` 那套子会话。 **Windows 10 19045 上实测到三条限制**，工具会直接拒绝，不返回假成功： | 限制 | 表现 | 原因 | |---|---|---| | 不支持桌面命名 | `rename` / `create(name=)` 抛 `NotImplementedError` | 命名是 Win11 22000+ 的能力，19045 的 vtable 里没有 `SetName` | | 新建不自动切换 | `create` 返回 `switched:false` | Win11 会切，Win10 不切 | | `move_window` 只搬本进程窗口 | 别的进程的窗口抛 `PermissionError` | 见下 | 第三条试过三条替代路线，在这个版本上都不可用： `IApplicationViewCollection.GetViewForHwnd` 加 `MoveViewToDesktop`（`QueryService` 返回 `E_NOTIMPL`）、 `Shift+Win+←/→` 系统加速键（忽略合成输入）、各种指针封送写法（都是同一个 `E_ACCESSDENIED`）。 和权限无关：同一 token、同一会话下，自己的窗口能搬，别人的不能。 ## 结构 ``` dsh-gui-forkgo/ ├── dsh-bundle/ ← 装进 DSH 的就是这个目录 │ ├── package.json │ ├── cordis.patch.yml 挂 MCP 客户端 + 技能扫描根 │ ├── skills/ │ │ └── gui-desktop/SKILL.md │ ├── vendor/windows-mcp/ windows-mcp 0.8.9 源码树（本分支改动在这里） │ ├── locale/{zh,en}.json │ ├── docs/DETAIL.md │ └── selftest.js 结构 + 技能 + 连接层自检 ├── docs/虚拟桌面计划.md 子会话的调查与实测记录 ├── .github/workflows/ci.yml ├── package.json ├── CHANGELOG.md ├── README.md └── LICENSE ``` ## 自检 改完先跑一遍，不需要 dsh： ```powershell npm run selftest # 结构 + 技能 + 连接层 npm run selftest:offline # 只验结构与技能 ``` 连接层会真起一次 MCP。依赖已经在缓存里时约 5 秒，首次要拉 Python 3.14 和依赖， 实测 11 秒左右。 ### 改完源码怎么生效 用本地目录装法时，改代码不会自动生效，有两道坎： ``` 改源码 → 关掉插件行 include:gui → 删掉 vendor/windows-mcp 下的所有 __pycache__ → 重新打开插件行 ``` **为什么必须删 `__pycache__`**：Python 会优先用 `.pyc` 里的旧字节码。改完源码 不删缓存，进程重启后跑的可能还是旧逻辑，而且看不出任何征兆——我在这上面浪费过 一整轮排查，明明代码改了、进程重启了，行为还是旧的。 一条命令清掉： ```powershell Get-ChildItem dsh-bundle\vendor\windows-mcp -Recurse -Directory -Filter __pycache__ | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force ``` 它挡的是三类「改对了也看不出来」的问题： 1. **包结构** —— `dsh.bundle.patch` 是否存在、`args` 里有没有相对路径、 `PYTHONPATH` 是不是由 `!!js` 反解而不是写死的绝对路径、`vendor/` 是不是完整的源码树。 2. **技能 frontmatter** —— `name` 是否为 kebab-case 且与目录名一致、`description` 是否为空。 缺 description 时 dsh 不会加载，也不报错，表现是「AI 不会用」。 3. **连接层** —— 真起 stdio、列工具，确认 15 个工具里 `VirtualDesktop` 与 `IsolatedSession` 都在、名字不重复、屏幕文案是中文。 ## 与上游的关系 包本体是 [`windows-mcp`](https://pypi.org/project/windows-mcp/) 0.8.9 的副本加改动， 放在 `dsh-bundle/vendor/windows-mcp/`，用 `PYTHONPATH` 覆盖；依赖仍由 `uvx` 从 PyPI 安装。 上游是 MIT，版权声明随附在 `vendor/windows-mcp/LICENSE-upstream.md`。 不用 `uvx --from <本地目录>` 的原因：uvx 对本地目录的构建缓存不看文件 mtime， 改完源码它照样复用上一次构建的产物。实测把整份文案改成中文之后跑起来还是英文， 也没有任何提示。`PYTHONPATH` 能让源码直接生效。 代价是那个目录必须放完整源码树，不能只放改动的文件。`PYTHONPATH` 一旦命中， 同名子模块全部从那里取，缺文件就是 ImportError。 ## 隐私 - 屏幕内容不出本机：没有遥测、没有崩溃上报、没有使用统计 - 唯一的出站行为是 `uvx` 首次启动时从 PyPI 拉依赖 - 截图落在 DSH 会话目录下（`.dsh-pilot/` 或你指定的 `save_path`）。敏感窗口不要截 - `IsolatedSession` 存的密码留在本机凭据管理器里，用当前账户的 DPAPI 加密， 不经过网络，也不写进任何配置文件 ## 已知限制 - 只支持 Windows：UI Automation 和虚拟桌面 API 都是 Windows 专有 - 默认会占用真实的鼠标键盘，人在键盘前动一下就会互相干扰。用 `IsolatedSession` 开子会话可以避免，代价是一次 Windows 密码 - `PowerShell` 是整机 shell，不受 DSH 文件沙箱限制。删文件、改注册表之前要先说一声 - canvas、WebGL、游戏画面这类只有像素没有控件树的界面必须走 `use_vision`， 成本更高，而且要靠看图判断 ## 故障排除 | 问题 | 解决方案 | |------|---------| | 工具列表里没有 `mcp__gui__*` | 确认 `include:gui` 是 active；看插件页有没有启动失败 | | 插件显示 failed 但手动能起 | DSH 缓存了失败的连接状态，把插件关掉再打开一次 | | **改了源码但行为没变** | **删掉 `vendor/windows-mcp` 下的 `__pycache__` 再重启**。`.pyc` 旧字节码会盖住新代码，且毫无征兆 | | 蓝光和提示面板一直挂着不消失 | 智能体忘了交还控制权。调 `ControlStatus(release=true)`；1.2.2 起 120 秒无动作会自动交还 | | `VirtualDesktop` 不存在 | `vendor/windows-mcp` 没被带上，跑的是 PyPI 上游的 21 工具版 | | 屏幕提示还是英文 | 同上，`PYTHONPATH` 没指到 `vendor/` 里的源码 | | 技能不出现 | 跑 `npm run selftest`；缺 description 会跳过且不报错 | | 首次调用很慢 | `uvx` 冷启动要拉 Python 3.14 与依赖，约 5 秒；之后走缓存 | | `initialize` 超时 | 先手动跑一次 `uvx --python 3.14 --from windows-mcp windows-mcp --help` 预热 | | `IsolatedSession` 报 1909 | 账户被锁了。本机策略是 10 次失败锁 600 秒，等一会儿或换管理员账户解锁 | | `start` 一直不到就绪 | `status` 看 `credential_saved` 是不是 true；看 `%TEMP%\dsh-gui-host-ready.txt` 有没有生成 | | `stop` 说关了但会话还在 | 1.2.2 之前的版本只关宿主不注销会话。升级到 1.2.2+，或用 `WTSLogoffSession` 手动清 | | `VirtualDesktop` 传错桌面 | 1.2.2 起 `index` 统一从 1 开始。之前 `list` 返回 0 起、`target` 按 1 起解析，会差一位 | ## 许可 MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
