# Coreutils Bash for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

这个 Bundle 将 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）在 Windows 上的 Bash 工具切换为由 Microsoft Coreutils 支持的原生 Bash，同时保留官方 PowerShell 能力。标准/ptc/cordis 预设同时提供一次性 `bash` 与 `pwsh`；minimal 预设同时提供持久 Bash 与持久 PowerShell。

## 工作原理

Bundle 通过一份 [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) 补丁层接入 DSH 的标准组合流程：

- 保留根组合中的 `pwsh-sandbox` 执行器（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox`），供 permission-presets 使用；每个可执行 Agent 预设再建立两个互不共享 `ctx.shell` 的隔离组：官方 `pwsh-sandbox` + `tool-pwsh`，以及本包的 `coreutils-bash-sandbox` + `tool-bash`。这样 Bash 和 PowerShell 各自保留完整的沙箱、审批与工具语义，不会因为两个 provider 注册在同一作用域而冲突。
- 重写 `standard`、`ptc`、`cordis`、`minimal` 四个内置预设的 Shell 行：前三者同时启用 `tool-bash` 与官方 `tool-pwsh`，minimal 同时启用持久 Bash 与官方 `tool-pwsh-persistent`；Bash 与 PowerShell 分别位于独立的 `shell`/`terminals` 隔离域。
- 向持久终端组（`optional-persistent-terminals`，来自官方终端 Bundle）注册 `coreutils-bash` 后端；该 Bundle 未启用时此插入被跳过并给出警告，不影响其余功能。
- 只有 Bash 子进程的 `PATH` 最前面会加上 Coreutils 命令目录和 bash 所在目录，并设置 `DSH_COREUTILS_BASH=1`、`DSH_COREUTILS_BIN`；原生 pwsh 的命令解析环境不受影响。

Harness 现有的沙箱模式、审批流程、超时预算、输出限制、取消机制和进程清理均保持生效。

## 前置要求

- Windows（本 Bundle 只在 Windows 上有意义）。
- Git for Windows 或 MSYS2，提供 `bash.exe`。
- Microsoft Coreutils，可通过 `winget install Microsoft.Coreutils` 安装。
- 通过 CLI 标准流程安装时需要 `pnpm` 在 `PATH` 中。

Microsoft Coreutils 提供的是 `ls`、`cat`、`grep`、`find` 等原生 Windows 工具（基于 uutils），它并不是 Bash 解释器。因此本 Bundle 需要同时安装上述两个组件，并且绝不会静默回退到 PowerShell。

## 安装

本 Bundle 是标准的 DSH 第三方 Bundle（`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`），可通过 DSH 标准安装流程安装：

以下方式走同一条标准安装流程，效果一致：

- **桌面版 / Web 界面**：侧栏「插件」页 → 安装，填入安装 spec，一键完成。
- **Agent 工具**：让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin add <spec>`（指定 profile 用 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <spec>`）。

推荐从 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-coreutils-bash) 安装：在插件安装页填写 `dsh-coreutils-bash`，或执行：

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-coreutils-bash
```

不指定版本时安装 npm 的 `latest` 版本；需要固定版本时使用：

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-coreutils-bash@2.0.0
```

支持的安装 spec：

| 形式 | 示例 |
| --- | --- |
| npm（推荐，latest） | `dsh-coreutils-bash` |
| npm（固定版本） | `dsh-coreutils-bash@2.0.0` |
| 本地目录（绝对路径） | `D:\github\dsh-coreutils-bash` |
| GitHub 仓库 | `github:fqscfqj/dsh-coreutils-bash` |
| Git URL | `git+https://github.com/fqscfqj/dsh-coreutils-bash.git` |

GitHub / Git URL 安装跟随仓库默认分支，可能包含尚未发布到 npm 的改动。

安装即默认启用。安装与启用会作用于该 profile 下的所有会话；`plugin_manager` 工具操作需要 `danger-full-access` 权限或当次审批。若依赖已存在（例如此前以 `link:` 方式手工接入），标准安装会报告 `already-installed`，先移除再安装即可走完整流程。

补充说明：

- 从本地目录安装时以 pnpm `link:` 方式接入，安装日志中的 peer dependencies WARN 属预期现象——这些 peer 由 DSH 运行时自身提供，不影响使用；GitHub / Git URL 安装为复制安装，不会出现该警告。
- 安装作用于整个 profile；以安装操作返回的 `application` 和 `nextStep` 为准。显示 `applied` 时不需要重启。

### 验证安装

在任意会话的 Bash 工具中执行：

```bash
echo "$DSH_COREUTILS_BASH"; command -v ls; ls --version
```

预期输出 `DSH_COREUTILS_BASH=1`、Coreutils 目录下的 `ls`，以及 `ls (uutils coreutils) …` 版本行。

## 配置

默认解析器会检查常见的 Git for Windows、MSYS2 和 Microsoft Coreutils 安装位置（`C:\Program Files\Git`、`C:\msys64`、`C:\Program Files\coreutils`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\coreutils`、scoop 及 `PATH`）。如果安装位置非标准，可以在插件行中覆盖以下字段：

### 执行器（`dsh-coreutils-bash/executor`）

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cwd` | `process.cwd()` | 命令工作目录 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次命令超时 |
| `maxTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 超时上限 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `64000` | 输出截断阈值 |
| `maxSpillBytes` | `67108864` | 溢出文件上限 |
| `graceMs` | `3000` | 终止宽限期 |
| `bashPath` | 自动解析 | `bash.exe` 完整路径 |
| `coreutilsPath` | 自动解析 | `coreutils.exe` 可执行文件路径；无标准位置时显式设置 |
| `coreutilsBinPath` | 自动解析 | Coreutils 命令目录，必须包含 `ls.exe`、`cat.exe`、`grep.exe`、`find.exe` |

### 终端后端（`dsh-coreutils-bash/terminal`）

除同样的 `bashPath` / `coreutilsPath` / `coreutilsBinPath` 覆盖外，还支持：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backendType` | `coreutils-bash` | 注册到 `ctx.terminals` 的后端名 |
| `shellDialect` | `bash` | 仅支持 `bash` |
| `shellPath` / `shellArgs` | 由 runtime 推导 | 覆盖 shell 启动命令与参数 |
| `rows` / `cols` | `40` / `160` | PTY 初始尺寸 |
| `scrollbackLines` / `scrollbackMaxBytes` | `10000` / 4 MiB | 回滚缓冲 |
| `maxReadBytes` | `262144` | 单次读取上限（不得大于回滚字节上限） |
| `pollIntervalMs` / `exactProbeAfterMs` | `50` / `150` | 就绪轮询 |
| `idleSilenceMs` / `handoffGraceMs` | `3000` / `500` | 静默与交接宽限 |
| `promptTailGraceMs` | `0` | 提示符尾随容忍 |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 启动就绪超时 |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | 关闭宽限 |

## 预设行为

- `standard`、`ptc` 和 `cordis` 同时提供一次性 `bash` 与 `pwsh`，每次调用都是新进程。
- `minimal` 同时提供持久 `bash` 与 `pwsh`：Bash 的 `cd`、`export`、函数和 PowerShell 的变量、函数、已导入模块各自保留；两者不共享当前目录或进程内状态。
- 官方持久终端面板在 Windows 上优先选择 `pwsh`、其次 `powershell`。本包另行注册类型为 `coreutils-bash` 的后端，不更改面板的首选 Shell。

## 保留 PowerShell 能力

在 `pwsh` 工具中直接使用 PowerShell 语法，不经过 Bash 解析。例如，对象从创建、筛选到取属性都留在同一个 PowerShell 管道中：

```powershell
1, 2, 3 | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Value = $_; Double = $_ * 2 } } |
  Where-Object Double -gt 2 | Select-Object Value, Double | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
```

cmdlet、模块、Windows 路径、`$env:NAME`、注册表 provider 和 PowerShell 内的对象管道仍由原生 PowerShell 提供。本插件不把这些能力翻译成 Bash，也不重新实现 PowerShell 执行器。

边界与原生 DSH 一致：

- 一次性 `pwsh` 使用 `-NoProfile`，不会自动加载用户 profile；需要的模块应在命令中显式 `Import-Module`。跨调用状态使用 minimal 的持久 `pwsh` 或官方 PowerShell 持久终端。
- `read-only` 的 ConstrainedLanguage 限制 .NET 非核心类型、`Add-Type`、COM、反射等能力；workspace-write 或主机策略也可能限制操作。保留 pwsh 不会绕过沙箱或获得管理员权限。
- 跨 Bash/PowerShell 进程传递的是字节/文本，不是活对象；需要结构化结果时显式 `ConvertTo-Json`，回到 PowerShell后再 `ConvertFrom-Json`。
- 旧版或仅有 Bash 的会话仍可显式启动子进程：`pwsh.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$items = 1, 2, 3; $items | ForEach-Object { $_ * 2 }'`。外层单引号防止 Bash 展开 `$`；复杂脚本用 `-File` 加 Windows 路径或 UTF-16LE Base64 `-EncodedCommand`。子进程不保留 pwsh 状态，仍受父进程沙箱约束；遇到权限拒绝不要换 shell 重试。

默认继续使用 Bash 处理常规命令和 Coreutils；涉及 Windows 原生管理或 PowerShell 对象处理时使用 `pwsh`。无需取消本插件或在同一 shell provider 上切换方言。

## 故障排查

解析失败时，执行器会抛出包含以下内容的诊断信息：实际检查过的 `bash.exe` 候选路径、检查过的 Coreutils 命令目录、以及安装指引。遇到时：

1. 确认 `bash.exe` 可在 Git Bash/MSYS2 中直接运行。
2. 确认 Coreutils 命令目录中存在 `ls.exe`、`cat.exe`、`grep.exe`、`find.exe`。
3. 在插件行中显式设置 `bashPath`、`coreutilsPath` 或 `coreutilsBinPath`。

仓库自带两个自检脚本（需要 Node.js）：

```bash
node scripts/test-resolve.mjs   # 验证 runtime 解析与真实 bash 执行
node scripts/probe.mjs          # 在受控 PATH 下探测 bash + Coreutils 组合
```

## Windows 注意事项

Bash 命令使用 Bash 语法以及 Git Bash/MSYS2 的路径约定。Microsoft Coreutils 遵循 Windows 的 ACL 与进程语义，因此不要假设 POSIX 信号、`/dev/null`、Unix 权限以及所有 GNU 工具的行为与 Linux 上完全一致。

## 兼容性

2.0.0 仅支持 DSH `0.2.3-alpha.2`。本包会替换四个内置预设的完整配置；只验证 Shell 命令可执行，不足以证明其他 DSH 版本的预设和沙箱行为兼容。升级宿主前请确认有对应的插件版本；仍在使用旧宿主的用户请固定安装 `dsh-coreutils-bash@1.1.0`。

升级 DSH 时，可用 `npm pack @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.2.3-alpha.2` 获取目标宿主包并解压，再运行 `node scripts/parse-patch.mjs --upstream <解压后的package目录>`。它逐项比较四个预设的所有非 Shell 配置，包括顺序和 Loader 表达式。

## 开发

在 Windows 上安装开发依赖后运行：

```powershell
npm install
npm test
npm run test:runtime
npm run test:pwsh
```

`npm test` 检查预设结构，并通过模拟的宿主进程验证 argv、环境、沙箱拒绝、取消、后台和持久终端启动。后两条命令分别运行本机的 Bash/Coreutils 和 PowerShell；它们不是操作系统沙箱的端到端测试。
- `scripts/test-resolve.mjs` — runtime 解析与真实 bash 执行的自检。
- `scripts/probe.mjs` — 受控 PATH 环境下的 bash + Coreutils 探测。
- `scripts/load-installed.mjs` — 从已安装 profile 加载执行器模块做冒烟检查。

## 开源协议

本项目基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。

# dsh-publish-helper

DSH 插件上架 / 发布 / 撤回助手：发现、检查、生成 entry、开 PR、一键发布 npm、按版本撤回。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin install_bundle --target npm:dsh-publish-helper
```

装完重启 DSH。第一次使用前在终端完成一次认证，插件会自动读取，不需要手填 token：

```bash
gh auth login    # GitHub：提交/审核/开 PR
npm login        # npm：发布/撤回
```

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `publish_discover` | 按 `dsh-plugin` topic 搜仓库（star 排序） |
| `publish_check` | 7 项上架检查：repo / topic / bundle / npm / repository / registry / catalog |
| `publish_entry` | 生成 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` |
| `publish_pr` | 复用或创建 fork（落后先同步）→ 写 entry → 开 PR |
| `publish_audit` | 扫一个 npm 用户的包，标出 `needs-registry` / `needs-catalog` / `no-repository` / `ready` |
| `publish_prepare` | 给 `package.json` 补 `repository` / `homepage` 并升 patch |
| `publish_repo` | GitHub API 建仓库并上传目录（不用 git） |
| `publish_npm` | 用本机保存的 npm token **直接发布**（先过 preflight，`--access public`，可带 OTP） |
| `publish_preflight` | 本地提交自检：字段 / dsh.bundle / README / LICENSE / install 脚本 / 二进制 / 密钥 / 绝对路径 |
| `publish_recall` | `deprecate` 打警告 / `unpublish` 下架**单个版本** |
| `publish_org` | 管理 npm org 成员：list / verify / invite / remove（owner token） |
| `publish_workflow` | 把 GitHub Actions 发布模板写进包目录 |
| `publish_submit` | 本地包 → 预检 → 推分支到 fork → 向 submissions 仓库开 PR |
| `publish_review` | 拉取提交 PR → 下载代码 → 预检 → 把报告贴回 PR |
| `publish_spec` | 返回完整提交规范（字段、禁项、流程、撤回） |

## 给 AI 的规范（装插件即生效）

插件激活时会向每个 agent 注入一段「DSH 插件提交与发布规范」，所以别人问 AI「怎么提交 / 怎么发」时，AI 已经知道标准，不需要你每次解释。完整规范可用 `publish_spec` 工具取。

交接物固定为：**包目录/zip + `SUBMISSION.md`**（模板见 [templates/SUBMISSION.md](templates/SUBMISSION.md)）。缺 `SUBMISSION.md` 不进入审核。

维护者只需要：审核 → `publish_check` → `publish_prepare` → `publish_npm`（或 CI）→ `publish_entry` → `publish_pr`。

规范要点：

- `package.json` 必须有 name/version/description/license/repository/homepage/keywords + `dsh.bundle.patch`
- README、LICENSE 齐全
- 禁止 install 脚本、二进制/构建产物、混淆代码、密钥、绝对路径
- 只发审核过的 commit；不保存他人账号

## 提交入口（B：GitHub PR）

[dsh-plugin-submissions](https://github.com/fubai-fenzhi/dsh-plugin-submissions)：每个插件一个目录，PR 提交，CI 自动跑 preflight，维护者合并即通过。

```text
submissions/<pkg>/
  package.json · README.md · LICENSE · SUBMISSION.md · 源码
```

- CI：`.github/workflows/preflight.yml`
- 审核报告模板：`docs/REVIEW.md`
- 合并后由作者自己发，或按 SUBMISSION.md 授权代发

## 审核队列（面板）

侧边栏 **Publish** → 顶部「审核队列」：

- 列出 `dsh-plugin-submissions` 的待审 PR：编号、标题、作者、commit、CI 状态、已审/未审
- 点「运行审核」：插件拉取 PR 代码 → preflight → 把报告贴回 PR，并在面板里直接显示结果
- 报告缓存到 `~/.dsh/publish-helper-reviews.json`，关掉面板也能再看
- 「打开 PR」跳到 GitHub 做最终 review / Merge

## 一键发布（面板）

一个包一次，点一下就完成「自检 + 发布」：

1. 侧边栏 **Publish** → 填包目录
2. 点 **自检并发布**：先跑规范自检（字段、dsh.bundle、README/LICENSE、install 脚本、二进制、密钥、绝对路径），PASS 才发 npm
3. 不看自检结果直接发布时，`publish_npm` 会拒绝；确需跳过要显式 `force`

token、tag、OTP、扫描都收在「高级」折叠里，默认界面只有包目录 + 一个按钮；上架检查交给 AI 的 `publish_check` 工具，不再占面板。

### 凭据：自动读取，不用手填

| 操作 | 来源 | 一次性准备 |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub | `gh auth token` → 环境变量 → 本机配置 | `gh auth login` |
| npm | `~/.npmrc` → `NPM_TOKEN` → 本机配置 | `npm login` |

面板只显示「已连接（gh CLI / ~/.npmrc）」，**不回显 token 值**；token 也不进对话。

## GitHub Actions + Trusted Publishing（A：推荐）

```bash
# 把模板写进包目录
node bin/publish-helper.mjs workflow ./my-plugin
```

然后在 npm 包页面 → **Settings → Trusted publishing** 绑定 GitHub 仓库 + workflow 文件名 `release.yml`。

之后：

```bash
git tag v0.2.0
git push --tags
```

CI 跑测试 → `npm publish --provenance`，**零 token、零 OTP、带 provenance**。

- 首次发布一般要先本地/CI 发一次把包建出来，再开 trusted publishing
- workflow 需要较新的 npm CLI（模板里会 `npm install -g npm@latest`）

## 撤回

| 方式 | 何时用 | 命令 |
|---|---|---|
| `deprecate` | 随时，安装时看到警告 | `npm deprecate <pkg>@<ver> "<reason>"` |
| `unpublish` | **发布 72 小时内** | `npm unpublish <pkg>@<ver> --force` |

面板「撤回」或工具 `publish_recall`。需要 npm token 对该包有发布权限（自己的包 / org owner / `npm owner add` 的 co-owner）。

> 超 72 小时只能联系 npm support 或举报；所以发布后要尽快复查。

## 责任边界

- 插件**不存储他人的账号/密码**；token 只存本机 `~/.dsh/publish-helper.json`
- 发布前必须人工审核目标 commit；每次发布/撤回写入 `~/.dsh/publish-helper-log.json`（时间、包名、版本、目录）
- 撤回是事后手段，不能替代审核；恶意包的第一道闸门仍是「只发审过的代码」

## CLI

```bash
node bin/publish-helper.mjs discover dsh-procedures
node bin/publish-helper.mjs check fubai-fenzhi/dsh-procedures
node bin/publish-helper.mjs workflow ./my-plugin
```

## 设置页 / 面板

- 侧边栏底部 **Publish** 按钮 → 悬浮面板（自检并发布 / 撤回 / tag / 扫描）
- Settings → 插件 → **Publish Helper** 同一个界面

## 检查项

| id | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `repo` | 仓库可达，返回 star 数 |
| `topic` | 仓库带 `dsh-plugin` topic（被发现渠道检索的前提） |
| `bundle` | `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`（可安装的前提） |
| `npm` | 已发布到 npm |
| `repository` | npm 包的 `repository` 回链该仓库（市场关联下载量的前提） |
| `registry` | 已被 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 收录 |
| `catalog` | 已进入 format-1 市场索引（npm 元数据可能滞后，单独提示） |

`catalog` 不计入整体 `ok`，因为它依赖注册表的每日构建。

# dsh-empty-turn-guard

**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A small [DSH (DeepSeek-Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin for one
family of failures: the model's reply **is not a usable answer** — it stops
halfway into leaked protocol markup, the stream goes quiet and never finishes, it
loops on empty `<thinking>` pairs, or it hands back a chain of thought instead of
a reply. The harness would treat any of these as a finished turn; this plugin
reclassifies them as **retryable errors** so the step is retried instead of
silently ending.

It is a DSH **bundle** (a package with its own `cordis.patch.yml`) and installs
without touching any DSH file.

## Features

- **Catches the "half an answer" turn.** Measured over 11 946 assistant messages,
  the common shape is *not* an empty reply — it is prose that stops and is
  followed by `</｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke>` / `</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>`. That is what the user
  sees as "the output froze halfway". Caught and retried.
- **Catches the reply that opens with markup.** When a relay drops the prose and
  emits only the parameter block, the reply never starts being an answer.
- **Catches the call that never closes.** Prose, then `<parameter name=…` with no
  `</parameter>`: the model began composing a call and the stream ended inside it.
- **Catches a stalled stream.** No chunk for 90 s becomes `TIMEOUT`; a stream that
  ends without a `finish` chunk becomes `TRANSPORT`. Text that already arrived is
  still delivered to the transcript.
- **Cuts repetition off early.** Twelve empty `<thinking> </thinking>` pairs with
  nothing else aborts the stream instead of paying for the whole loop — one
  measured case emitted 255 pairs before ending on its own.
- **Evidence-based, so it does not eat real replies.** The judgement is about
  *where* a marker sits, not whether one exists: 43 of the 130 measured
  residue-bearing messages were correct answers that **quote** the markup while
  explaining the bug. All of them pass untouched, including a 1 750-character
  report and a 2 089-character answer wrapped in an unclosed `<thinking>`.
- **Five switches, no numbers.** Master switch plus one per judgement; the
  thresholds are constants so a settings page can never be tuned into false
  positives.
- **No dependencies at runtime.** Host half imports only a schema library; the
  browser half is a hand-written bundle with no build step.
- **Logs the length, never the text.** Diagnostics carry `text=24ch`, so model
  output does not reach log files through this plugin.

## Install

```sh
# straight from GitHub (works today)
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:FYTXY/dsh-empty-turn-guard

# from a local checkout, for development
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-empty-turn-guard

# from npm — not published yet, this line will fail with E404 for now
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-empty-turn-guard
```

`dsh plugin … add` forwards its arguments to pnpm, so GitHub shorthands, tags and
branches work too (`github:FYTXY/dsh-empty-turn-guard#v0.5.0`).

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Built-in plugins → Empty-turn guard** and
turn the switch on.

<details>
<summary>Installing without the CLI</summary>

1. Put this directory somewhere stable, e.g. `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-empty-turn-guard`.
2. Link it into the profile's `node_modules` (symlink or Windows junction).
3. In the profile's `package.json`, add the package name to **both**
   `dependencies` and the `dsh.profile.bundles` array.
4. Restart DSH.

Do not insert a bare path row into `cordis.patch.yml` instead: that mounts the
plugin as a plain module rather than a bundle, and the settings card will not
appear.

With a `link:` or manual install, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` resolves from the
copy DSH already ships. If Node reports `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND:
@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, point at that copy:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path ".\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery" `
  -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery"
```

A GitHub install handles this through pnpm and needs no extra step.

</details>

## Configuration

### 1. The five switches

All of them live in the plugin's own tab under **Settings → Built-in plugins →
Empty-turn guard**, and the master switch is also on the bundle's card in the
sidebar **Plugins** panel. Thresholds are not exposed: they are constants in
`lib/index.js`, because every one of them was chosen from measured samples and a
number field invites tuning into false positives.

| Switch | Default | What it treats as a failed turn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | on | Master switch. Off = unload the guard entirely. |
| `toolCallResidue` | on | The reply ends in markup, opens with markup, or walks into a `<parameter>` block it never closes. |
| `streamStall` | on | No chunk for 90 s (`TIMEOUT`), or the stream ends without a `finish` chunk (`TRANSPORT`). |
| `repetition` | on | Twelve empty `<thinking> </thinking>` pairs with nothing else in the text. Aborts early instead of waiting for the loop to end. |
| `thinkingLeak` | **off** | A short reply (≤ 400 characters of prose) that is entirely inside an unclosed `<thinking>`. Off by default: real samples exist where a complete, correct answer lost its closing tag, and only length separates the two. |

Turning `enabled` off unloads the plugin and restores the untouched `llm/stream`
chain, which brings the silent half-turn back. The other four are judged per
request, so flipping them applies to the next model call with no restart.

Both entry points write the same value — the package's entry in the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles` array — so either works:

| Entry point | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Settings → Built-in plugins → **Empty-turn guard** | The plugin's own tab: all five switches, what they currently do, and save / discard |
| Sidebar → **Plugins** panel | The master switch on the bundle's card |

The row-level toggle for this plugin's row is greyed out on the Plugins panel.
That is expected: DSH only enables or disables *rows* through the profile's own
patch file, and this plugin's row comes from the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`.
The bundle switch is the one that takes effect.

### 2. Disabling a judgement without unloading

To keep the package installed but skip one judgement, give the row a config:

```yaml
- id: dsh-empty-turn-guard
  name: 'dsh-empty-turn-guard'
  config:
    repetition: false
```

Every field is volatile, so it arrives as a live reference rather than a frozen
value; the guard re-reads all switches on every request.

### 3. Verifying it is running

In the host log (`%APPDATA%\DSH Desktop\logs\host\dsh-<date>.log` on Windows,
`~/.config/DSH Desktop/logs/host/` on Linux):

```
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] empty-turn-guard: mounted (broken steps become retryable errors)
```

And when a judgement actually fires — the line names the rule, the discarded
length, and the error code it became:

```
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] rewriting a markup-only stop (text=24ch) into EMPTY_RESPONSE
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] rewriting a tool-call-residue stop (text=159ch) into TRANSPORT
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] rewriting a stream-stalled attempt (no chunk for 90000ms) into TIMEOUT
[dsh-empty-turn-guard] rewriting a stream-truncated attempt (no finish chunk) into TRANSPORT
```

An `llm/retry` / `llm/retry-started` event usually follows — that is the retry
running.

## How it works

```
LLM call
  └─ llm/stream  ◀── this plugin wraps here (global, prepended)
     └─ adapter stream (openai-responses | anthropic-messages)
        └─ chunks: block-start / text-delta / block-end / usage / finish

while streaming:
  probe the text so far
    empty-thinking pairs ≥ 12, rest empty   ⇒  abort upstream, error EMPTY_RESPONSE
    no chunk for 90 s                       ⇒  error TIMEOUT
    stream ended with no finish chunk       ⇒  error TRANSPORT

on finish:
  reason.kind === "stop" AND no tool call observed
    stripMarkup(text) === ""                ⇒  error EMPTY_RESPONSE   (markup-only)
    endsInResidue(text)                     ⇒  error TRANSPORT        (hangs on markup)
    startsInResidue(text)                   ⇒  error TRANSPORT        (opens on markup)
    hasUnclosedCall(text)                   ⇒  error TRANSPORT        (never closes it)
    thinkingLeak && isThinkingLeak(…)       ⇒  error EMPTY_RESPONSE   (opt-in)
  otherwise                                 ⇒  yield the chunk untouched

error
  └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry: all three codes are in DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES
     └─ retries the step (5 attempts, 500 ms initial, 10 s cap, 10 % jitter)
```

`llm/stream` is the single funnel every model call passes through, and the
waterfall lets a listener wrap the provider's chunk stream instead of reacting
after the fact. Rewriting the `finish` chunk — rather than editing text or
injecting a message — keeps the conversation history clean and reuses the retry
machinery the provider already declares. A step that fails this way never appends
an `assistant/message`, so the half-written text does not reach the transcript
either.

**Position, not presence.** The whole design turns on one measurement: 43 of the
130 residue-bearing replies in the corpus were *correct answers* that quoted the
markup while explaining this very bug. So a marker existing proves nothing. What
distinguishes a broken reply is that no prose follows the last marker
(`endsInResidue`), that no prose precedes the first one inside the opening 40
characters (`startsInResidue`), or that a `<parameter>` block was opened and never
closed (`hasUnclosedCall`).

The `HEAD_WINDOW = 40` constant is load-bearing: measured false positives appear
at 80, 120 and 300, because the quoted markers in a real answer sit 65–71
characters in.

Two filters keep the interception narrow. Requests that declare no tools are
skipped, because background calls (session titles, compaction) stream the same
way and an empty reply there is expected. `max-tokens` is skipped because a
truncated answer is a genuine answer.

**Retry, never parse.** The plugin deliberately does not turn leaked DSML back
into a tool call. A parser that mis-reads one argument executes the wrong
command; a retry only costs a provider round-trip.

The failure this targets, the measurements behind it, and why switching protocol
does not help are documented in **[docs/root-cause.md](docs/root-cause.md)**.

## Compatibility

- **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (verified on this release).
- **Node.js >= 22.**
- Uses only existing seams: the `llm/stream` waterfall and the `EMPTY_RESPONSE`
  error code. No DSH file is modified.
- `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is a **peer dependency** supplied by DSH.
- The schema keeps a `.volatile()` field on purpose. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`
  drops any namespace whose schema has none — silently — and the settings card
  would vanish. See the note at the end of
  [docs/root-cause.md](docs/root-cause.md).

## Non-goals

- **Does not repair the relay.** The markup still reaches the message body; it
  just no longer pretends to be a finished turn.
- **Does not parse the markup back into a tool call.** Deliberate: a parser that
  mis-reads one argument executes the wrong command, which is a worse outcome
  than a retry.
- **Does not sanitise history.** Messages already on disk keep their residue.
- **Does not catch every residue position.** Residue that sits between the 40th
  and 400th character, with prose on both sides, still passes (2 of 128 measured
  samples). Widening the window starts eating correct answers instead — the
  trade-off is documented in `docs/root-cause.md`.
- **Does not guarantee the retry succeeds.** If the relay only ever returns
  residue, the retries are exhausted and you get a clear error — still better
  than a silent half-answer.

## Development

There is no build step. `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js` are the shipped
artifacts.

```sh
npm run check   # node --check on both entry points
npm test        # node --test over tests/
```

`lib/client.js` is a hand-written ModuleLoader bundle because the browser runner
loads it by evaluating `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. It may
require only `react`, `react/jsx-runtime` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`. Do not introduce a bundler for it.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the review bar, and
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the plugin's security boundaries.

## Repository Layout

```
dsh-empty-turn-guard/
├── lib/index.js           # host half: the llm/stream guard (no runtime deps)
├── lib/client.js          # browser half: the settings card + plugins card
├── cordis.patch.yml       # bundle patch: mounts the plugin row
├── package.json           # dsh.bundle.patch and dsh.client point at the above
├── tests/                 # node:test suites for both halves
│   ├── guard.test.mjs
│   └── client-bundle.test.mjs
├── docs/root-cause.md     # the failure this plugin targets, with evidence
├── .github/workflows/     # CI: Node 22 + 24 on Linux and Windows
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── CONTRIBUTING.md
├── SECURITY.md
└── LICENSE
```

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-empty-turn-guard
```

Or turn the switch off in **Settings → Built-in plugins → Empty-turn guard**.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# Semantix memory for DeepSeek Harness This local DSH bundle recalls project memory before the first model request and captures completed text turns. It uses a Semantix CLI built from a version that includes `codex-hook`. Put that executable on the DSH process's `PATH`. The headless workflow has been verified with DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` on Linux amd64 using Node.js `24.22.3` and Semantix built from source. From the Semantix checkout, install the bundle in the profile you use: ```sh dsh plugin --profile headless add ./plugins/semantix-dsh-memory dsh --profile headless "Describe the project convention we used before" ``` Run the second command from your project directory. For another profile, use its name in both commands. Remove the bundle with: ```sh dsh plugin --profile headless remove @semantix/dsh-memory ``` Memory uses the canonical Git workspace root or, outside Git, the session working directory. The DSH store defaults to `~/.semantix/dsh`, separate from the Codex plugin store. Set `SEMANTIX_DSH_DATA_DIR` to an absolute directory to override it. Uninstalling the bundle preserves this directory. To search one project's store explicitly, use `semantix search --scope project --db --query `. The plugin sends admitted user text and a completed turn's final assistant text to the local Semantix process. Recalled text is labeled as historical data when inserted into a model request. Failed or unavailable recall lets DSH continue. The plugin uses the CLI's existing payload and context limits. To repeat the headless verification from the checkout, run `python smoke.py ` from this directory. It installs and removes the bundle in a temporary DSH profile and uses a loopback model stub for both Chat Completions and Messages streaming.
# Semantix ### Cross-session memory and work reuse for AI coding agents. **Semantic Caching · Adaptive Scheduling · Speculative Prefetch · Cross-Session Learning** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.7.3-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/releases) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Gnosil/semantix?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/stargazers) [![GitHub contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/Gnosil/semantix?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/graphs/contributors) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-semantix.ensureok.ai-168b6d?style=flat-square)](https://semantix.ensureok.ai) **English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Quickstart](./docs/QUICKSTART.md) · [Technical Overview](./docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md) · [Website](https://semantix.ensureok.ai)

> **A new coding session often repeats project discovery and tool work. Provider prefix caches can reuse computation for matching prefixes, but do not decide which experience from an earlier session is still relevant or valid.** > > Semantix addresses both: a complete coding agent with the memory kernel built in, and a standalone kernel that attaches to an agent already in use. ## Quick start **Install** — one line, macOS / Linux (arm64 / amd64): ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gnosil/semantix/main/agent-skill/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` This drops `semantix` + `semantix-agent` into `~/.local/bin` and turns on cross-session memory. **Use it** — start the agent inside any project; that folder becomes the workspace: ```bash cd ~/your-project semantix # bare command → launch the coding agent here (first run sets up provider / API key) semantix search "..." # any subcommand → the memory kernel (search / extract / inject / verify / usage) ``` Pin a version or arch with `... | sh -s -- v0.7.3 arm64`. Other install methods and the full command reference live in [docs/QUICKSTART.md](./docs/QUICKSTART.md). ## Two ways to run it **`semantix-agent` — the complete agent.** A CLI coding agent shipping with the memory kernel built in: extraction, retrieval, injection and the evolution loop are wired at boot, with provider presets for ~50 endpoints. **The kernel — attached to an existing agent.** Harness-independent by design; the integration surface is a small set of hooks (tool registration, message interception, session export / event bypass). Three ways in: | Path | Integration cost | Applies to | | --- | --- | --- | | **Agent skill** | `semantix install --target claude-code` | Claude Code | | **Tool registration** | two tool schemas (`semantix_lookup` / `semantix_inject`) | custom / self-hosted agents | | **Gateway** | configure upstreams and point the client at the gateway base URL | OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions clients | Memory integration is designed to fail open: on kernel error the agent falls back to its normal execution path. Direct result reuse is fail-closed: a failed validation rejects the cached result. ## Cross-session memory A project's build conventions, test layout and service flags often need to be re-established in a new session. Semantix extracts reusable **slices** from finished sessions — task patterns, project knowledge, tool sequences and results — into a local scored library, and reinjects relevant slices when a similar task appears. Each hit carries its retrieval zone (🟢 hit · 🟡 grey · ⚪ miss) and its source session — real `semantix search` / `dashboard` / `verify` output lives in the [reuse visualization walkthrough](./docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md#reuse-visualization). Usage and feedback signals can update slice scores and retrieval thresholds. Type-aware eviction treats reusable project knowledge differently from short-lived results. These mechanisms support tuning; improved precision still needs to be measured on the target workload. ## What the kernel reuses Semantix connects cross-session memory to three levels of reuse: | Layer | Current mechanism | What it can save | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1 · Provider prefix cache** | Gateway prefix hygiene and provider-aware cache handling help preserve matching prefixes | Repeated prompt computation, subject to the upstream's cache policy | | **L2 · Context reuse** | Retrieve relevant slices and assemble a budgeted context block with provenance | Repeated project discovery and instructions | | **L3 · Result reuse** | Return a stored result after relevance, isolation and validity checks pass | The main answer-generation call; grey-zone judging may still call a model | Three implementation choices are central to this approach: - **Validity checks for code-related results.** L3 checks captured dependency files using mtimes and SHA-256 fingerprints. The gateway also enforces conversation-context and model isolation and applies an age policy. Dependency-free results require explicit opt-in; gateway ingestion leaves that opt-in off by default. Checks cover captured dependencies, so external state and unrecorded dependencies still need revalidation. See [the L3 decision path](./kernel/cache/l3.go). - **Separate retrieval from permission to reuse.** Hit / Grey / Miss zones guide admission. L2 drops grey candidates by default, with an optional audit mode; L3 requires judge approval for grey candidates and rejects them when no judge is available. A judge approval still has to pass the isolation and dependency checks. See [L2 admission](./kernel/inject/inject.go) and [retrieval zones](./kernel/zone/zone.go). - **Use behavior history as well as facts.** Task patterns, project context, tool sequences, results and memory units have different uses. In the bundled agent, tool-pattern learning feeds scheduling and speculative read-only prefetch, with outcome feedback. This execution integration depends on the harness; pointing a client at the gateway alone does not install a tool scheduler. See [the kernel bridge](./harness/semantix/bridge.go). The default retrieval path is local BM25 and does not require a vector database or an embedding service. CLI search and the gateway also support vector and hybrid retrieval. The default vector backend uses deterministic token-hash embeddings; model embeddings are opt-in and use an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint. The gateway's configured model backend uses HNSW indexing. Hash embeddings do not provide the same semantic capabilities as a trained embedding model. See [retriever construction](./gateway/retriever.go) and [the configuration reference](./docs/QUICKSTART.md). ## Cache hit rate and cost Provider prefix caches reuse matching prompt prefixes, with token/block granularity, minimum lengths and lifetimes determined by the serving stack. Changes near the start can invalidate much of an otherwise reusable prefix. `semantix-gateway` removes recognized attribution/billing marker lines from the head of the first system message and sorts tools by name by default. This removes two sources of prefix churn before forwarding. The implementation and tests are in [the prefix-hygiene middleware](./gateway/sanitize.go) and [its tests](./gateway/sanitize_test.go); workload observations are recorded in [the prefix audit](./docs/reports/glm-p0-1-prefix-audit.md). The design goal is to make the provider cache hittable rather than to work around it: - **Deterministic context assembly** — admitted slices are ordered by relevance score, with ID as a stable tie-break within each zone. Different queries, scores or metadata can still change the injected bytes; similar meaning alone does not guarantee a prefix-cache hit. - **Prefix hygiene** — per-request attribution markers are stripped and the tool array is canonicalized by name, removing client enumeration order as a source of invalidation. - **Provider awareness** — a vendor capability table, cache-control policies and per-model price tables. The gateway's configurable per-vendor L3 age windows are local reuse policy; they do not control the upstream's prefix-cache lifetime. - **L3 result reuse** — an eligible result is returned without the main generation call, fail-closed; optional grey-zone judging has its own cost. ### Per-provider adaptation Cache behaviour is determined by the stack serving the model rather than by the model itself, and the spread is wide enough to require per-stack adaptation. | Endpoint | Prompt-cache hit, steady turn | Where the number comes from | | --- | --- | --- | | DeepSeek | **99.8%** | provider-reported cache tokens | | GLM (measured hosting stacks) | **97.5%** | week-long spike; observed ~97.6% telemetry ceiling | Both are observed per-turn prompt-token hit rates — `hit / (hit + miss)` over cache token counts returned by the provider. They are workload-specific observations, not guaranteed rates or measures of memory relevance. `semantix-agent` displays the current turn's rate alongside the session average in its status line when the provider reports cache usage. A week-long GLM study measured the same model behind different hosts and found cache lifetimes differing several-fold: one stack held a prefix for 1–8 minutes with real expiry in `(8, 12]`; another maintained 96–98% for 120 seconds and had fallen to 28% at 301 seconds. These measurements motivate per-stack calibration. The report also documents an observed **~97.6%** telemetry ceiling on the measured stacks, where trailing partial blocks were not counted as cached. Method and raw runs: [docs/reports/glm-spike-week.md](./docs/reports/glm-spike-week.md) · [docs/reports/glm-p0-1-prefix-audit.md](./docs/reports/glm-p0-1-prefix-audit.md). Beyond caching, the scheduler learns tool-usage patterns to parallelize eligible calls and to prefetch read-only context during model wait time. ### Evidence and evaluation limits - **79.8% modeled cost saving** in a synthetic demo, assuming 80% of repeated tool steps can be avoided and estimated tokens per step. This is a cost-model illustration, not a measured production billing reduction — assumptions in [docs/reports/m0-cost-comparison.md](./docs/reports/m0-cost-comparison.md). - **80% cache hit rate (L3/L2)** on a small demo library (4 extracted sessions) — the one-screen `semantix dashboard` snapshot is captured in the [reuse visualization walkthrough](./docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md#reuse-visualization) - The default replay verdict (`semantix verify`) uses an **auto-classified Hit share of ≥ 70%**. Its output labels this `relevance`, but that statistic is not human-labeled precision. Optional `--labels` calibration supports oracle-based evaluation; real-session relevance validation is tracked in [#58](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/issues/58). **These are replay / demo measurements, not production benchmarks.** The full evidence trail — and everything else technical — lives in [docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md](./docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md). ## Try it in 30 seconds Installed via the one-liner above? Extract slices from a past session, then reuse them — this is the memory kernel at work: ```bash semantix extract --input session.jsonl --db .semantix/project.db --project demo semantix search --query "fix failing go test" --db .semantix/project.db semantix inject --query "fix failing go test" --db .semantix/project.db # L2 reuse block semantix verify --session --project demo # replay verdict (auto-Hit share ≥70%) semantix dashboard # one-screen snapshot ``` Prefer to build from source (Go 1.26+)? `go build -o semantix ./cmd/semantix && go build -o semantix-agent ./cmd/semantix-agent`. Full command reference and configuration: [docs/QUICKSTART.md](./docs/QUICKSTART.md). ## Integrations | Agent / harness | Integration path | Status | | --- | --- | --- | | Semantix Agent | Built-in bundle: `[semantix] enabled=true` + `semantix_lookup` tool | ✅ shipped since v0.3.0 | | Claude Code | Tool registration via `semantix_lookup` / `semantix_inject` schemas | ✅ documented (`agent-skill/tools/`) | | Codex CLI | Opt-in local marketplace plugin with project memory hooks | [Setup and diagnostics](./plugins/semantix-memory/README.md) | | DeepSeek Harness (DSH) | Local Host bundle for automatic project recall and capture | Verified with [DSH headless](./plugins/semantix-dsh-memory/README.md) | | LangChain apps | Middleware with two hooks (message rewrite + session extraction) | ✅ documented ([report](./docs/reports/langchain-middleware.md)) | | Custom / self-hosted | Session bypass: export / event bypass / direct call | ✅ documented (`agent-skill/hooks/session-bypass.md`) | | OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions clients | `semantix-gateway` in front, configured upstreams and custom base URL | ✅ shipped | | Milvus (vector DB) | Optional compose stack (docker-compose.milvus.yml) + MCP server; orchestrator does RAG, Semantix caches LLM calls | ✅ documented ([guide](./docs/integrations/milvus.md)) | Other agents can integrate through tool registration, supported gateway requests or session export. Compatibility depends on the client's protocol and available hooks; the paths above do not imply that every client has a tested adapter or the bundled agent's full execution integration. Concrete integration requests are tracked as [issues](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/issues) (template: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/integration_request.yml`). ## Documentation | Doc | What's inside | | --- | --- | | [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md) | Shipped / in progress / next (English summary) | | [docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md](./docs/TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md) | **Start here** — concepts, cache layers, scheduler, prefetch, evolution loop, architecture, module map, status, roadmap, metrics | | [docs/QUICKSTART.md](./docs/QUICKSTART.md) | Install, 30-second demo, command reference, configuration | | [docs/Agent-Infra-架构设计.md](./docs/Agent-Infra-架构设计.md) | Full architecture design (Chinese) | | [docs/Agile路线图.md](./docs/Agile路线图.md) | Agile 1–3 roadmap and definition-of-done (Chinese) | | [docs/Security-安全设计.md](./docs/Security-安全设计.md) · [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) | Threat model and security mechanisms | | [agent-skill/SKILL.md](./agent-skill/SKILL.md) | Self-serve integration for any harness | | [semantix.ensureok.ai](https://semantix.ensureok.ai) | Website, product docs and the blog | ## Community - 💬 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/discussions) — Q&A, ideas, show & tell - 🐛 [Issue tracker](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/issues) — `good first issue` is the place to start - 📖 [Blog](https://semantix.ensureok.ai/blog) — semantic caching and agent-memory write-ups ## Contributing Semantix is early-stage. Contributions are welcome across semantic caching, retrieval, scheduling, speculative execution, evaluation methodology and harness adapters — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for the workflow (branch from `main`, PRs require green `go vet` and `go test -race`). Issues and PRs in English or Chinese are both fine. **Without writing code:** run `semantix verify` against your own sessions and post the resulting hit rate to [#58](https://github.com/Gnosil/semantix/issues/58). Aggregated community results decide the v1.0 gate. Architectural assumptions are open to challenge; testing them is part of the work. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE). [DeepSeek-Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) (MIT). ---
### Semantix **Every interaction should make the next one cheaper, faster, and smarter.**

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-hermes-bridge

English | [简体中文](./README_zh.md)

A bidirectional local bridge plugin between **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** and **Hermes Agent** on the same Linux workstation, enabling remote Telegram supervision and natural-language control of local DSH sessions.

* **Upstream (DSH → Hermes → Telegram)**: Listens for DSH tool approval requests (`approval/request`), interactive user questions (`user-questions/request`), debounced LLM/stream failures (HTTP `402`/`429`/auth/stream errors), and `turn/end` completions. Assigns sequential short request numbers (`[#1]`, `[#2]`, …), formats multiple-choice questions with lettered options (`A`, `B`, `C`) and option descriptions, and pushes payloads signed with HMAC-SHA256 V2 to Hermes's local webhook adapter (`mirror_to_session: true`).
* **Downstream (Telegram → Hermes → DSH)**: Reply to Hermes in plain natural language on Telegram. Hermes (guided by [`hermes/skills/dsh-bridge/SKILL.md`](./hermes/skills/dsh-bridge/SKILL.md) and the MCP tool schemas) converts your intent—including mapping question replies into a strict JSON Schema—and invokes one of 5 tools on the local StreamableHTTP MCP Server (`http://127.0.0.1:8790/mcp`).
* **Concurrent Dual-Surface Racing**: Desktop DSH Web UI and Telegram race via `Promise.race`. Whichever surface responds first wins and settles the pending store; when Telegram answers first, the bridge aborts the downstream UI `AbortSignal` so the browser modal closes immediately without starving or breaking the Web UI.

---

## Architecture & Directory Layout

```text
dsh-hermes-bridge/
├── package.json                # DSH Cordis bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch + peerDependencies)
├── cordis.patch.yml            # Default DSH bundle Cordis patch configuration
├── tsconfig.json
├── lib/                        # Tracked compiled JS & .d.ts outputs (no install-time build script needed)
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts                # Cordis plugin entrypoint (name, inject, Config schema, apply)
│   ├── types.ts                # Bridge & DSH host service TypeScript interfaces
│   ├── pending-store.ts        # Pending approvals/questions store, short IDs, timeouts, strict answer validator
│   ├── event-listeners.ts      # DSH event listeners, debounce, UI signal cancellation, summary formatting
│   ├── webhook-client.ts       # Hermes Webhook client (idempotent X-Request-ID, HMAC-SHA256 V2, retries)
│   └── mcp-server.ts           # Loopback StreamableHTTP MCP Server (5 control tools + /health)
├── tests/
│   ├── pending-store.test.ts
│   ├── event-listeners.test.ts
│   └── mcp-server.test.ts
├── hermes/
│   ├── skills/dsh-bridge/SKILL.md
│   └── config.example.yaml
└── scripts/
    └── setup-hermes.sh
```

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Build & Test (for local development)

```bash
pnpm install
npm run build
npm test
```

> **Packaging Note**: All `@deepseek-ai/*` host packages are declared solely under `peerDependencies`, and the plugin has zero runtime `dependencies` to avoid Dual-Package Hazard. Because DSH uses `pnpm` v12's strict supply-chain policy (which blocks `prepare`/`prepack` build scripts for git-hosted packages unless explicitly listed in `allowBuilds`), this repository intentionally omits lifecycle build scripts and tracks compiled artifacts under `lib/` directly in Git. Whenever you edit files under `src/`, run `npm run build` so `lib/` stays in sync.

### 2. Configure Hermes (Skill + Webhook + MCP)

Run the setup helper script:

```bash
./scripts/setup-hermes.sh
```

This script:
1. Symlinks `hermes/skills/dsh-bridge` to `~/.hermes/skills/dsh-bridge`;
2. Generates random `DSH_HERMES_MCP_TOKEN` and `DSH_HERMES_WEBHOOK_SECRET` values (or reuses values already exported in your environment);
3. Prints the configuration snippet to merge into `~/.hermes/config.yaml` (see [`hermes/config.example.yaml`](./hermes/config.example.yaml) for the full template, including optional LLM-polished mode);
4. Probes `http://127.0.0.1:8644/health` and `http://127.0.0.1:8790/health`.

After updating `~/.hermes/config.yaml`, restart the Hermes Gateway (e.g., `hermes gateway restart`) so the webhook route, MCP server, and updated tool schemas take effect.

### 3. Install & Mount in DSH

Export the shared secrets in the environment where DSH runs (or override `config` for `id: dsh-hermes-bridge` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`):

```bash
export DSH_HERMES_MCP_TOKEN="<matches Hermes mcp_servers.dsh_bridge Authorization Bearer token>"
export DSH_HERMES_WEBHOOK_SECRET="<matches Hermes webhook route secret>"
```

* **Option A: Install directly from GitHub into a DSH profile (Recommended)**

  ```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web add "github:grubwithu/dsh-hermes-bridge#main"
  ```

  To pull new commits later:

  ```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-hermes-bridge
  ```

* **Option B: Link local working copy (Best for active plugin development)**

  ```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web add "link:/path/to/dsh-hermes-bridge"
  ```

* **Option C: Pack a local `.tgz` tarball**

  ```bash
  npm run build && npm pack
  dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-hermes-bridge/dsh-hermes-bridge-0.1.0.tgz
  ```

  > **Important**: Because this package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`, installing it via `dsh plugin add` mounts it automatically. Do **not** add another `- insert: - id: dsh-hermes-bridge` entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (which causes `duplicate loader entry id`). To customize plugin config per profile, patch the existing entry by `id: dsh-hermes-bridge`.

* **Option D: Ephemeral `--patch` debugging without installing**

  Create a local `dev-patch.local.yml` (gitignored) pointing `name` to the absolute path of `lib/index.js`:

  ```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: dsh-hermes-bridge
        name: /path/to/dsh-hermes-bridge/lib/index.js
        config:
          mcpHost: "127.0.0.1"
          mcpPort: 8790
          hermesWebhookUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8644/webhooks/dsh-events"
  ```

  Launch DSH with:

  ```bash
  dsh --profile web --patch ./dev-patch.local.yml
  ```

---

## Configuration Reference (`Config` / `cordis.patch.yml`)

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mcpHost` | `"127.0.0.1"` | Bind address for the MCP HTTP server (loopback only when auth token is empty) |
| `mcpPort` | `8790` | Listening port for the MCP HTTP server (`0` for ephemeral port in tests) |
| `mcpAuthToken` | `""` (fallback: `DSH_HERMES_MCP_TOKEN`) | Bearer token for `POST /mcp`; if empty, non-loopback requests are rejected with `403` and a startup warning is logged |
| `hermesWebhookUrl` | `"http://127.0.0.1:8644/webhooks/dsh-events"` | Target URL of Hermes's local webhook receiver |
| `hermesWebhookSecret` | `""` (fallback: `DSH_HERMES_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) | HMAC-SHA256 V2 secret (`X-Webhook-Timestamp` + `X-Webhook-Signature-V2`) |
| `approvalTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Timeout (ms) waiting for an approval decision (5 min); fails closed as `rejected` |
| `questionTimeoutMs` | `1800000` | Timeout (ms) waiting for a user question answer (30 min) |
| `notifyOnTurnEndMinDurationMs` | `0` (`10000` in `cordis.patch.yml`) | Minimum turn duration (ms) to emit a `stopped` webhook on normal completion (`durationMs === 0` is never suppressed) |
| `errorDebounceMs` | `60000` | Per-session, per-error-category debounce window (60s) |

---

## MCP Tools Exposed by `dsh-hermes-bridge`

All tools are served over StreamableHTTP at `POST /mcp` (plus `GET /health` for readiness checks):

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh_list_status` | Lists all pending approvals, pending user questions (with `[#N]` short IDs and `A`/`B`/`C` option codes), active DSH sessions, and optional `recentStopped` turns. |
| `dsh_decide_approval` | Approves (`allowed-once` or `allowed-session`) or rejects (`rejected`) a pending approval by `#N`, `N`, or full `apr_xxxx` ID. Returns `EXPIRED_OR_RESTARTED` if already settled or restarted. |
| `dsh_answer_question` | Submits an answer to a pending `ask_user_question` prompt (both `open` and timed `continued` modes) using a strict JSON Schema: `{ pendingId, answers: [{ questionIndex, selected, custom? }] }`. `selected` accepts exact option letters (`"A"`, `"B"`, …) or exact labels and validates single/multi-select rules strictly without silently falling back to `custom`. |
| `dsh_send_instruction` | Sends a follow-up user message (`inject` / `followup` / `steer`) to a live DSH session. Refuses with `PENDING_QUESTION_EXISTS` if the session has an unanswered question to prevent triggering `ASK_ABORTED`. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancels the active turn of a DSH session (`agent.cancel({ kind: "user" })`). |

---

## Key Behaviors & Design Guarantees

* **Short Request Numbers (`#1`, `#2`, …)**: Every notification (`paused_approval`, `paused_question`, `interrupted_error`, `stopped`) carries a short sequence identifier (`shortId`), making it easy to disambiguate or reference specific requests when multiple sessions pause around the same time.
* **Structured Multiple-Choice Rendering**: Both single-question and multi-question prompts render each question with its index, single/multi-select tag, prompt text, lettered options (`A`, `B`, `C`, …), and option descriptions.
* **Strict LLM-to-Schema Question Answering**: Hermes LLM translates the user's natural-language reply into `{ pendingId, answers: [{ questionIndex, selected, custom? }] }`. The server strictly validates question count, single-select constraints, and option letters/labels (returning `INVALID_ANSWER_SCHEMA` with valid choices on mismatch).
* **Fail-Closed & Stale-Safe**: Approvals time out as `rejected`; stale or post-restart actions return `EXPIRED_OR_RESTARTED`; duplicate LLM rate-limit/quota errors (`429`/`402`) are debounced within `errorDebounceMs`.

---

## License

MIT

# Liquid glass for DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A floating-glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a living background, and
the sidebar, conversation header and composer as panes of one frosted-glass
family — plus an optional wallpaper, a particle whale and a settings page.

![Liquid glass preview](docs/preview.svg)

Style only. The bundle injects a stylesheet and a few decorative layers into the
page; it changes no behaviour, reads no session data, makes no network requests,
and turning it off restores the stock interface exactly.

## Screenshot

The settings page and dialog in the DSH desktop build (light theme); the
wallpaper thumbnail is pixelated on purpose:

![Settings page and dialog](docs/screenshots/settings.jpg)

## Features

- **Living background** — three slowly drifting colour fields over a deep base,
  with a whisper of grain; or your own image wallpaper.
- **Floating cards** — sidebar, conversation header and composer share one glass
  recipe (translucent fill, hairline border, lit rim, drop shadow, backdrop
  blur); the composer adds a specular highlight that follows the pointer.
- **Glass menus** — popovers, menus and the settings dialog become frosted
  sheets; the settings mask becomes a soft veil instead of a flat scrim.
- **Settings page** — under **Settings → 液态玻璃**: master switch, blur, frost,
  background type, motion, brightness, wallpaper (pick / replace / remove, with
  its own blur and frost), particle whale, page-edge fades.
- **Details** — a particle whale watermark in the conversation column, page-edge
  fades, and a glass rim around the window frame.
- **Accessibility fallbacks** — `prefers-reduced-transparency`,
  `prefers-contrast: more` and `prefers-reduced-motion` drop the effects and fall
  back to the host's opaque surfaces.

## Install

This repository is a DSH bundle package: the files at the root are the package
itself (`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` half).

1. Download or clone this repository.
2. In DSH open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**.
3. Paste the **absolute path to this folder** (the one containing `package.json`)
   into the “package name or address” field and install.
4. If DSH asks for a restart, restart it once; then enable **Liquid glass** in the
   plugin list and reload the page.

Settings and the wallpaper stay in this browser's `localStorage`; they do not
travel with the repository.

## Tuning

The settings page writes these CSS custom properties on
`html[data-liquid-glass]`; a user stylesheet can override them directly:

| Property | Meaning | Default (light / dark) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--lg-blur` | Card backdrop blur | `20px` |
| `--lg-frost` | Card fill multiplier | `1` |
| `--lg-brightness` | Background brightness, 50 is unchanged | `50` |
| `--lg-glass` | Card fill | `46%` white / `50%` graphite |
| `--lg-sheen` | Diagonal sheen | `26%` / `6%` white |
| `--lg-deep` | Background base colour | `#d2e6ee` / `#061c22` |
| `--lg-blob-a` / `-b` / `-c` | Background colour fields | aqua / blue / violet |
| `--lg-hairline` | Card border | `rgb(15 36 60 / 12%)` / `rgb(148 180 220 / 26%)` |
| `--lg-rim` | Lit rim | `rgb(255 255 255 / 70%)` / `rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` |
| `--lg-specular` | Pointer highlight on the composer | `50%` / `12%` white |
| `--lg-wallpaper-blur` / `-frost` | Wallpaper blur / frost | `0px` / `12%` |

## Compatibility and limitations

- Built against **DSH 0.2.2-rc.5**. Surfaces are matched by class-name fragments
  and data attributes the shell renders today (`sidebarCol`, `[data-slot]`,
  `_card` inside `[data-composer-seat]`, `header[data-window-drag]`,
  `[data-menu-material]`, `[data-shortcut-modal="settings"]`). A future release
  that renames them degrades to the stock surfaces instead of breaking.
- The **Windows desktop caption strip** is handled for the desktop build (the
  script reserves 40 px and injects a DOM menu bar). The web build has no caption
  strip, so those rules simply do not apply.
- The desktop window itself stays opaque: true desktop transparency needs
  Electron window flags (`transparent` / `backgroundMaterial`), which a web
  bundle cannot set.
- Because the base colour is transparent, host surfaces that fade or dim *to*
  that colour no longer mask content behind them.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 鱼的心跳 · dsh-self-clock

一个会自己定闹钟的插件。到点了，它在同一条会话里给自己留一句「到点了」——不是用户消息，不派任务，也不替你安排什么。

内置的 `schedule` 是一张张写好的时刻表；心跳是**会话自己决定**什么时候该醒。想每隔半小时看一眼、想在夜里某个点回头捡起一件事，一句话就够，不用先去写一条 cron。

## 它做的事

- **模型自己设**：`heartbeat_set({ inMinutes: 30, label: "把刚才那半段写完" })`，三十分钟后在原会话醒一次，带着你留的那句话。
- **不是提醒你，是提醒它自己**：投的是一条 `notice`，出现在对话里，不弹窗、不响铃、不冒充你说过话。
- **会看你在不在**：到点先读会话日志正文，判断你刚说完话没有、我上一条回复多久了。你正说着话，它就不响。
- **一口气能关**：总开关、频次、时段、每日上限、临时静音，都在设置页里点，不用改文件。

## 和内置 `schedule` 的区别

| | `schedule` | 心跳 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 谁定时间 | 你写在任务里 | 会话自己，随时改 |
| 提示词 | 写死的 | `label`，一句「上次停在哪」 |
| 到点不响的理由 | 没有 | 会告诉你是「太近」「在等你」「刚收尾」「不在时段」「预算用完」 |
| 看你在不在 | 不看 | 看正文，不看到 mtime |

## 什么时候不会响

开关只管「能不能响」；真到点还有五道闸，任何一条不过就安静跳过：

- 你上一条消息至少过去 5 分钟——刚说完话不打断
- 上一条你已经回过了，它没有在等你
- 它上一条回复也过去 2 分钟了
- 这条会话 10 分钟内没被叫过——只有半页的书房时间会避让心跳，心跳自己不避让
- 在时段内、今日预算没用完、没有临时静音

安静 5–20 分钟只说「到点了」；超过 20 分钟，连你留言的那句话一起说。

读不到会话日志（还没落盘、换了目录、文件坏了）时，五道闸一起失效，照时段和预算响——宁可白叫一次，也不漏。

## 装

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-self-clock
```

或者在 DSH 的「插件市场」里搜「心跳」，点安装。装完在「设置 → 心跳」里能看到面板。

## 说两句

装了就麻烦点个 ⭐（仓库右上角），让我知道有人在用；装不上、用着别扭、想要什么功能，直接在市场评论区留言或开个 issue——都会看到。

## 工具

### `heartbeat_set`

一条会话同时只挂一个闹钟，重复调用覆盖旧的。

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `inMinutes` | N 分钟后响一次（1–1440） |
| `everyMinutes` | 每隔 N 分钟响一次（5–1440） |
| `cron` | 五个字段：分 时 日 月 周，支持 `*`、`a`、`a,b`、`a-b`、`*/n`，例如 `30 7 * * *` |
| `label` | 唤醒时提示自己「上次停在哪」的一句话，不超过 80 字 |

三个时间参数只能给一个。返回里的 `nextAtLocal` / `statusText` / `window` 说明什么时候响、以及为什么没响。子会话拒绝设置。

### `heartbeat_config`

改这条会话的设置，只传要改的字段：`enabled`、`everyMinutes`、`windowStart` / `windowEnd`（0–23 小时，`start > end` 表示跨夜）、`dailyBudget`、`muteMinutes`。

### `heartbeat_mute`

临时静音，默认 30 分钟。期间不响、不消耗预算，到点自动恢复。

### `heartbeat_list`

看所有闹钟和「为什么没响」：`等待中 · 下次 09:30`、`已关闭（总开关）`、`不在时段（23:00–06:00，跨夜）`、`今日预算用完（48/48）`、`临时静音中 · 09:52 恢复`、`距上条消息太近（3 分钟）`、`⚠ 未排到下次触发`。

### `heartbeat_cancel`

取消本会话的闹钟，没有也算成功。

### `presence`

读会话日志**正文**，回答「他本人最后说话是什么时候、走的哪条通道」。不看 mtime——会话文件每轮都在写（系统注入、插件汇报都算），mtime 永远是新的。

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | 要查的会话；不填就是当前这条 |
| `maxScan` | 最多往前翻多少条 user 消息，默认 400 |
| `kinds` | 临时覆盖白名单，例如只看 `["qq"]` |

判据是三道闸，顺序固定：白名单（`ownerSourceKinds`）→ 必须含（`ownerSourceRequire`）→ 排除（`ownerSourceDeny`）。默认白名单是 `["user", "qq"]`，默认排除挡系统注入和定时提醒。

一个坑：落盘的 `user/message` 事件里不带 `source`，来源只活在 `agent/inbox/spliced` 的 `inserted[].source`。所以先建「正文 → 来源」表再对，对不上才当 `user`。

## 设置页

DSH 的「设置」里有一节「心跳」：

- 顶上一行：现在几点、今天已响几次、几个闹钟；右上角「新建」/「刷新」
- 一张表：会话 / 状态 / 开关 / 频次 / 上限 / 静音
- **新建**只列**现在还活着**（有会话开着）且还没闹钟的会话
- **上限**：每行自己的每日上限，改完立刻写回
- 表下一段「什么时候才会真叫一声」，就是上面那五道闸

## 落盘

`~/.dsh/heartbeat.json`（或 `$DSH_HOME/heartbeat.json`）：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "alarms": {
    "<sessionId>": { "mode": "interval", "everyMinutes": 30, "nextAt": 0, "label": "" }
  },
  "usage": { "date": "2026-11-24", "count": 3 }
}
```

`alarms` 是按 `sessionId` 的对象 map；`cronParsed` 不落盘（Set 序列化会变成空对象，读回来按 `cron` 重解析）。插件起来时读它，到点的立刻补响一次；卸载时定时器清掉，文件留着。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

```yaml
config:
  windowStart: 0
  windowEnd: 23
  dailyBudget: 48
  chatGraceMinutes: 5
  postReplyGraceMinutes: 2
```

`chatGraceMinutes` / `postReplyGraceMinutes` 就是「5 分钟」「2 分钟」两个门槛。

## 开发

```bash
cd "D:/dsh work/plugins/heartbeat"
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "D:/deepseek/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --test test/*.test.mjs
```

`core.test.mjs` 只测时间算法；`plugin.test.mjs` 用临时 `DSH_HOME` + 伪造 ctx 跑真实投递；`acceptance.test.mjs` 是工单验收；`presence.test.mjs` 测三道闸。

## 投递方式

照 DSH 自己的 schedule 运行时：

```js
const message = createUserMessage({ content: [{ type: 'text', text }], source: { kind: 'heartbeat', form: 'notice', summary } })
agent.followup(message)
await ctx.sessions.flush(agent.session)
```

会话没活着就 `ctx.sessionController.resolveAgent(sessionId)` 复活。`createUserMessage` 优先从宿主树里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 取（profile 里没有这个包），拿不到就用本地等价实现，对象形状一致。

## 许可

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-fullstack-expert

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）用的「全栈工程专家」组合包：常驻工程准则 + 技术栈探测 + 仓库规约抽取 + 仓库项目规则 + 可验证的只读检查 + 前端 / 后端 / 数据库 / 部署四个 Skill。

## 它贡献了什么

| 能力 | 实现 | 位置 |
|---|---|---|
| 常驻人设（工程准则） | `ctx.systemPrompt.section({ order: 1 })` | `src/index.ts` |
| 工程流程引导 | `ctx.systemPrompt.section({ order: 450 })` | `src/index.ts` |
| `stack_probe` 技术栈探测（只读） | 原始 `ToolDefinition` → `ctx.tools.register` | `src/index.ts` |
| `repo_conventions` 仓库规约抽取（只读） | 同上 | `src/index.ts` |
| `repo_guidelines` 仓库项目规则读取（只读） | 同上；只读 `.dsh/skills/*/SKILL.md` | `src/index.ts` |
| `run_checks` 只读检查执行 | 同上；只跑项目声明的 lint/typecheck/test | `src/index.ts` |
| 四个分层 Skill | `ctx.skills.register`（运行时注册） | `skills/*/SKILL.md` |

Skill 由插件自己注册进 `ctx.skills`，不需要改 `skill-filesystem` 配置。组合里没有 skills 服务时（例如极简 profile），插件照常加载，只是不注册 Skill。

## 四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `stack_probe` | 语言、框架、子项目、lint/test 命令、Makefile 目标、CI、容器 | 只读 |
| `repo_conventions` | 命名风格、测试位置、配置清单、`.env` 变量名、Git 提交风格、建议先读文件 | 只读（含 `git log`） |
| `repo_guidelines` | 读取仓库根 `.dsh/skills/*/SKILL.md` 的项目规则，可按 `topic` 过滤 | 只读 |
| `run_checks` | 跑项目声明的 lint / typecheck / test / build，返回状态、退出码、耗时与输出尾部 | lint/typecheck/test 只读；build 写产物，需显式请求 |

`run_checks` 的命令来源只有四种，不接受任意命令：

1. `package.json` 的 `lint` / `typecheck` / `test` / `build` 脚本；
2. 项目内 `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`（有 `tsconfig.json` 且未声明 typecheck 脚本时兜底，不产出文件）；
3. `go vet ./...`、`go test ./...`、`go build ./...`；
4. Makefile 的 `build` 目标（存在时优先，视为多栈仓库的完整构建入口，且不再重复跑子项目 build）。

`build` 会写产物、可能触发项目自己的依赖安装，因此不在默认检查里；传 `checks: ["build"]` 才执行。传 `dryRun: true` 只列出将要执行的命令、不实际运行。

试点仓库（lingua-ops：Go 单二进制 + React 前端）实测：

```
[✓ passed] .   lint      go vet ./...       0.8s
[✓ passed] web typecheck tsc --noEmit        1.8s
[✓ passed] .   test      go test ./...       2.3s
```

### 前端产物新鲜度（只读）

`repo_conventions` 会扫描 `//go:embed` 目录，再用 `vite.config.*` 的 `outDir` 反查出对应的前端项目，比较源码最新 mtime 与产物时间：

```
产物新鲜度：
- web/src → internal/webui/dist：stale（源码 2026-11-23 13:28:21 晚于产物 2026-11-23 10:40:03）
注意：web/src 比 internal/webui/dist 新，需重建前端，否则二进制里仍是旧 UI
```

`run_checks` 也会在结果说明里带上同样的提醒，避免「前端改了、二进制里还是旧 UI」。整个检查只读，不执行构建。

## 项目规则住进仓库

插件不内置任何具体仓库的业务规则。仓库自己的约定放在仓库根的 `.dsh/skills/<topic>/SKILL.md`，跟随 git 走：

```
<repo>/.dsh/skills/api-contract/SKILL.md
```

模型在动手前调用 `repo_guidelines`，工具结果里会带上命中的规则正文：

- 只读 `.dsh/skills/`，不把仓库里的任意文件当成指令；
- 传 `topic`（如 `api`、`frontend`）按名称、描述、`appliesTo` 与正文过滤；
- 单次返回上限 20KB，超出会截断并提示直接读文件；
- 未命中时明确返回「该仓库未定义项目规则」，模型退回通用 Skill，而不是沿用别的仓库假设。

规则写法用 [templates/repo-skill.md](templates/repo-skill.md)：frontmatter 里的 `name` / `description` / `appliesTo`，正文固定为 **不变量 / 必读文件 / 完成标准** 三段。试点仓库 lingua-ops 的样板在 `.dsh/skills/api-contract/SKILL.md`。

为什么不用 `ctx.skills.register` 注册项目 skill：那是进程级全局注册，一个会话切换多个仓库时，A 仓库的规则会污染 B 仓库。工具结果注入天然按调用作用域生效。

## 安装

前置：dsh `0.2.x`（Node 要求见 dsh 自身：`^24.22.3 || >=26`）。

仓库已提交构建产物 `lib/index.js`，从 GitHub 安装不需要 `prepare` 构建授权：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:OWNER/dsh-fullstack-expert
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # 应出现 "# == dsh-fullstack-expert" 层
dsh --profile web                 # → http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

终端出现 `[fullstack-expert] plugin loaded` 即加载成功。卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-fullstack-expert
```

本地目录也可以直接装成组合包，装完后会出现在 Web 侧边栏的「插件」页，可开关：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /Users/zhua/Doubao/chats/2026-11-23/new-chat/dsh-fullstack-expert
```

装成组合包后不要再叠加 `dev.patch.yml`，否则同一插件会被加载两次。

## 本地调试（不装成包）

插件运行时只依赖 Node 内置模块，从任意绝对路径都能通过 `--patch` 加载：

```sh
# 直接用已提交的构建产物启动，不需要 npm install
dsh --profile web --patch /Users/zhua/Doubao/chats/2026-11-23/new-chat/dsh-fullstack-expert/dev.patch.yml --no-open
```

launcher 参数要写在 app 名之前（`dsh --profile web --patch ...`），写成 `dsh web --no-open --patch ...` 会报 unknown option。

如果 dsh 自身的家目录不可写（例如沙箱环境），指定一个可写的 `DSH_HOME`：

```sh
DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home dsh --profile web --patch .../dev.patch.yml --no-open
```

终端出现 `[fullstack-expert] plugin loaded` 即加载成功。首次对话前需要在 Web 的 Models 页面填入
DeepSeek API Key（或在启动环境里导出 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`），否则 headless/对话会报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。

改了 `src/index.ts` 后重新构建（这一步需要 `npm install` 装开发依赖）：

```sh
npm install && npm run build
```

换目录或换机器时，改 `dev.patch.yml` 里的绝对路径。

## 可选：会话级 preset

默认安装后对**所有**会话生效。若只想在选定会话里启用，把
[agent.cordis.yml](config/agent-presets/fullstack/agent.cordis.yml) 的内容追加到 profile 的
`cordis.patch.yml`，然后在 Web UI 的 Agent 预设选择器里选「全栈专家」。

该 preset 的工具清单按 dsh 0.2.x 的包名编写；升级 dsh 后请对照官方的
`packages/bundle/web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml` 同步。

## 目录

```
dsh-fullstack-expert/
├─ package.json            # dsh.bundle 声明 + peer/dev 依赖
├─ cordis.patch.yml        # 组合包层（按包名引用插件）
├─ dev.patch.yml           # 本地调试层（绝对路径，不随包发布）
├─ tsconfig.json
├─ src/index.ts            # 插件源码
├─ lib/index.js            # 构建产物（提交进仓库，GitHub 安装直接可用）
├─ skills/{frontend,backend,database,deploy}/SKILL.md
├─ templates/repo-skill.md  # 仓库项目规则模板（不变量 / 必读文件 / 完成标准）
└─ config/agent-presets/fullstack/   # 可选 preset 片段
```

## 调试与自检

- 类型校验：`npm run typecheck`（需要先 `npm install`）。
- 改了 `src/index.ts` 后必须 `npm run build` 并提交 `lib/`，否则安装到的仍是旧产物。
- 加载失败先看终端：`inject` 漏写会报 `ctx.tools` / `ctx.systemPrompt` 未解析。
- 工具重名会直接失败；新增工具请保持 `stack_probe` / `repo_guidelines` 这类清晰命名，并在 `description` 里写清是否有副作用与读取范围。
- `run_checks` 会把 `exec.signal` 透传给子进程（SIGTERM，2 秒后 SIGKILL），并声明 `timeoutMs: 600000` 支持协作取消。
- 人设与流程段会被写进系统提示词前缀：不要把时间、git 状态、目录列表之类动态内容塞进 `section`，否则每轮都会击穿 KV cache。需要动态事实时让模型调用 `stack_probe`。

## 版本适配

- 面向 dsh `0.2.2-rc.5` 开发，`engines.dsh` 限制在 `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0`。
- 使用的公开契约：`ctx.systemPrompt.section`、`ctx.tools.register`（原始 `ToolDefinition`）、

# dsh-a6-failover

[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.5.1-blue.svg)](./CHANGELOG.md)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.2%20%3C0.4.0--0-purple.svg)](https://github.com/HSHSir/dsh-a6-failover)

DSH 的 A6API 中转站故障转移插件。收到正文、推理内容或工具调用之前，空响应、断流及可恢复的上游故障可触发换商家。开始输出后，插件保留已输出内容和错误信息。

## 0.5.1 变更

- **站点的「智能路由兜底」开关接线了**：`fallbackToSmartRouting` 现在真的随 pin 请求发给站点；开启后固定商家失效时由站点自己换商家，不再直接报「固定商家当前不可用」。开启期间不把用量归因到固定商家（否则实测命中率会串味）。
- **已输出内容后失败也会换商家**：这类失败本轮不能重放（会重复正文），但会把该商家短期拉黑（`postContentBadTtlMs`，默认 30 分钟），下一次请求直接避开；事件里记 `channel-quarantined`。
- **拉黑支持到期时间**：`bad` 表新增 `until`，短期拉黑到期自动恢复，不会像旧的 6 小时一刀切。
- **boot 事件带版本号**：以后翻 `events.jsonl` 就能看出哪次启动是哪一版。

## 0.5.0 变更

定价与选商家按**真实数据**重建，和 0.4.5 的口径不可比：

- **两侧命中率分开**：官网用自己的命中率（`officialCacheHitRate`，默认 0.95），商家用本机实测命中率；从没实测过的商家按 `unmeasuredMerchantCacheHitRate`（默认 0，即全按输入价）估，不再拿官网的命中率替它担保。
- **输出/输入比实测**：优先用本机 usage 的真实比值（至少 `outputRatioMinSamples` 次采样），输出贵的商家会因此变贵。
- **新增渠道级实测**：`state.outcomes` 记每条渠道的成功/失败次数（1 天半衰期）与首块延迟；可靠性用平滑失败率 `(实测失败 + 站点失败率×5)/(实测调用+5)`，延迟优先用实测首块时间。
- **打分改为成本 60 : 可靠性 30 : 延迟 10**（新增 `reliabilityWeight`）。缓存不再单列——它已经含在成本里，旧 `cacheWeight` 仅保留兼容。
- **报价线程配置白名单补齐**：`switcher.js` 的 `quoteKeys` 曾漏掉新配置键，导致线程内悄悄退回默认值。
- **未就绪不再打死请求**：首次请求等 `routeWaitMs`（默认 6000ms）仍没定下商家时默认放行原始请求（`allowUnpinnedFallback: true`），只在事件里记 `route-not-ready-passthrough`；预热并发从写死的 2 提到 `prewarmConcurrency`（默认 4），失败冷却 15s → 5s。

## 功能

- 只接管名称匹配 `^a6api` 的 provider，官方账号不会被接管。
- 根据输入、缓存读取、缓存写入和输出的实际用量计算成本。
- 实际价格超过官网价格 70% 的商家直接排除。
- 按**真实成本 + 实测可靠性 + 实测延迟**排序商家，并记录每次选择原因。
- 缓存折算优先采用本机实测命中率；没有实测时按保守值（全按输入价）估算。
- 同一路由的并发失败可复用仍有效的 pin。使用同一控制面令牌和模型的 provider 共用切换锁。
- 遇到明确的上下文窗口错误时，从已配置的路由中选择能容纳请求的更大窗口。
- 设置页支持修改令牌、用户 ID、价格/可靠性/延迟权重和切换策略。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/HSHSir/dsh-a6-failover.git"
```

固定到某个提交（可复现，推荐）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/HSHSir/dsh-a6-failover.git#<40位commit>"
```

### 从插件市场安装

在 DSH 的**插件 → 发现**中添加索引源，搜索「A6 换商家」后点安装。索引条目见 [`market/index.json`](./market/index.json)。

### 从源码目录安装

在插件目录执行：

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs
```

CLI web profile 使用：

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs --profile web
```

安装脚本会把插件复制到 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-a6-failover`，并在 profile 的 `node_modules` 中建立包链接。安装完成后必须完全退出 DSH（包括托盘进程）再重新打开。

### 发给其他人

运行打包脚本：

```powershell
node scripts/package-release.mjs
```

脚本会在 `dist` 目录生成带版本号的 ZIP。对方解压后，在解压目录运行 `node scripts/install.mjs`。

如果对方使用的是 CLI web profile：

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs --profile web
```

卸载：

```powershell
node scripts/install.mjs --uninstall
```

## 设置

重新启动后，在 DSH 的设置页打开 **A6 换商家**。常用选项包括：

| 分组 | 设置 |
|---|---|
| 站点接入 | 启用开关、provider 正则、控制面地址、a6api 系统访问令牌、用户 ID |
| 切换策略 | 是否启用站点智能路由兜底（fallbackToSmartRouting） |
| 价格线 | 官网价格比例、缓存命中率、输出/输入比例、美元汇率 |
| 排序权重 | 成本权重（priceWeight）、可靠性权重（reliabilityWeight）、延迟权重（latencyWeight）、实测命中率样本门槛 |
| 质量门槛 | p50 延迟上限、失败率上限、最少样本数 |
| 切换策略 | 单次与每小时上限、失败触发条件、备用路由、已输出后失败的拉黑时长（postContentBadTtlMs） |
| 上下文切换 | 自动切换大窗口路由、余量倍数、每小时上限 |

设置保存到 `$DSH_HOME/a6-failover/config.json`，保存后立即生效。令牌字段只显示“已设置”，不会回显完整值。点击“清除本地覆盖”可恢复 profile patch 中的配置。

访问令牌和用户 ID 会随控制面请求发往已配置的 HTTPS 站点，默认是 `https://a6api.vip`。凭据按站点绑定，控制面请求拒绝重定向。设置接口仅供本机使用。

受管路由使用严格固定的商家。每条模型流有插件切换预算，DSH 对首块内容前的可恢复错误仍按 provider 的重试配置执行。

### 首次路由和连续调用

在插件的 profile 配置中，通过 `prewarmRoutes` 指定启动时提前初始化的 `provider` 与 `model`。其他受管路由在首次使用时初始化。插件按价格和质量门槛选商家，递交固定请求后回查站点确认生效。并发请求共享初始化，每个冷请求最多等待 2 秒，超时返回 `A6_ROUTE_NOT_READY` 或使用已有的合规备用 A6 路由。初始化可继续在后台完成。

商家确认后，正常请求只复用内存里的路由。首块内容前发生故障时优先使用已准备好的候选。行情 JSON 的解析和候选排序在工作线程处理。

## 实际价格计算

商家报价按每百万 token 的美元价格以 micros 表示：

```text
实际单价 = (1 - 缓存命中率) × 输入价
         + 缓存命中率 × 缓存读取价
         + 缓存写入占比 × 缓存写入价
         + 输出/输入比例 × 输出价
```

商家实际价格与官网实际价格使用相同用量假设计算，二者相除得到实际比例。比例大于 `maxEffectiveRatio`（默认 `0.7`）的商家会被忽略。价格报告：

### 为什么缓存单独占一项

上面那条公式里的 `cacheHitRate` 是**你自己的用量假设**（对所有商家相同），而商家自己的缓存
表现才是**这家渠道实测的**——同样一份标价，缓存好的商家几乎全程按缓存读价计费，缓存差的
商家大部分按输入价计费，实际花费差好几倍。

所以排序把两件事分开算：

```text
总分 = ( 定价权重 × 成本分 + 缓存权重 × (1 − 缓存收益)
       + 延迟权重 × 延迟分 + 失败率权重 × 失败率 ) / 权重总和
```

**缓存收益取值顺序**

| 优先级 | 数据 | 来源 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 站点 24h 缓存率 | `GET /api/subscriptions` → `data.items[].auto_channels` / `auto_pool_preview.items` 的 `cache_hit_rate_bps`（10000 = 100%） | 最权威，但它**不在** `/api/marketplace/channels` 的 listing 里 |
| 2 | **实测命中率** | 我们自己每次成功调用的 usage：`cacheReadTokens / (inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens)` | **立刻生效**：切到某家商家后第一次成功请求就开始积累，默认攒够 3 次参与打分（`cacheMeasureMinSamples`） |
| 3 | 缓存读取成本 | 商家缓存读价 ÷ 官网缓存读价 | 站点与实测都缺失时，当前报价即可参与排序 |
| 4 | 中性 0.5 | 上面三者都没有 | 不奖不罚 |

- 默认 `priceWeight = 85`、`cacheWeight = 85`（等权，两边都是「贵不贵」的主因素），
  延迟 10、失败率 5；权重按总和折算，不需要凑成 100。
- 2026-11-23 实测，a6api.vip 的 1,386 条路由池记录均缺少缓存率。207 条同模型报价的缓存读价与输入价比值集中在 2%，因此回退使用相对官网的缓存读价。
- 本机样本存在 `~/.dsh/a6-failover/state.json` 的 `usage` 里，按站点、模型和渠道累计，
  半衰期三天（上游是否真的缓存住会随部署变化）。
- 仅当开流与结束时使用同一个已确认的固定商家，插件才记录该流的实测命中率。
- `cacheFallbackDiscount = false` 可以关闭缓存读价回退。`cacheMeasureMinSamples` 控制实测样本门槛。
- `cacheWeight = 0` 可以关闭缓存项的独立权重，成本、延迟和失败率仍按各自权重计算。
- 缓存**不参与淘汰**：站点缓存率样本少、还可能整片没数据，拿它卡门槛会把商家直接打死。
- 改完权重后，商家表里已算好的分数是按旧权重的缓存，点一次「重新拉取」才会按新权重重排。
- 商家表「缓存收益」列显示站点缓存率、实测命中率或缓存读价相对官网的比例。

```powershell
node scripts/price-report.mjs --model deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 --cache-hit 0.99 --output-ratio 0.0014
```

## 运行状态

插件使用 loopback HTTP 接口提供状态和配置：

```text
GET    /a6-failover/status
GET    /a6-failover/config
POST   /a6-failover/config
DELETE /a6-failover/config
POST   /a6-failover/refresh
```

事件日志位于：

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\a6-failover\events.jsonl" -Tail 30
```

常见事件类型包括 `model-failure`、`switched`、`pin`、`cache-sample`、`context-switched` 和 `context-switch-unavailable`。

## 测试

```powershell
node --test scripts/self-test.mjs
node scripts/check-encoding.mjs --strict
```

当前插件版本 `0.4.5`，需要 Node.js 18.17 或更新版本。

图标使用 A6API 页面引用的 `a6-icon-light.png`（128×128 PNG），随插件以 `assets/a6-icon.png` 分发。

## 数据与隐私

- 插件只读 DSH 的 provider 配置与 `~/.model_probe/routing.json`（若存在），用于取控制面凭据。
- 控制面请求只发往配置的 HTTPS 站点（默认 `https://a6api.vip`），拒绝重定向。
- 运行数据全部留在本机：`$DSH_HOME/a6-failover/state.json`（商家缓存、实测命中率、成败计数）与 `events.jsonl`（事件流，超过 4 MiB 轮转）。
- 仓库与安装包都不含任何密钥、令牌或运行记录。

## 开发

```powershell
node scripts/self-test.mjs        # 56 项自检，不联网
node scripts/package-release.mjs  # 生成 dist 下的 ZIP
```

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

# dsh-session-recovery

A system-maintenance plugin for DeepSeek Harness. After DSH starts, it looks for
conversations whose last turn never finished — a crash, a forced exit, or a
model call that failed — and resumes them so the work continues without you
reopening every session by hand.

## What it does

Once per boot, after a short delay:

1. Lists every persisted session and skips the ones that are already live,
   belong to a subagent, were archived, or whose working directory is gone.
2. Reads the tail of each remaining log and classifies the last turn:
   - no `turn/end` after its `turn/start`, or the turn ended as `interrupted` —
     the process died mid-turn;
   - the turn ended with `error` from the model provider;
   - the turn was aborted with the `disposed` cause — DSH quit while it ran.
   A turn you stopped yourself, a turn that completed, and a turn cut off by
   `max-tokens` are left alone.
3. Resumes the session through the ordinary session controller, so its agent
   preset, model selection, and working directory are restored exactly as the
   Web app would restore them.
4. Queues one follow-up user message that names the interruption and asks the
   model to continue from where it stopped. The message is prefixed with
   `[session-recovery]` so later rescans can recognize it.

Sessions that keep failing are retried at most `maxAttempts` times across
restarts, and only the `maxSessions` most recently created candidates are
touched in one boot.

## Install

From this repository checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:./packages/session-recovery
```

Or install the directory through the plugin manager. Restart the profile after
changing the plugin code.

## Configuration

All keys are optional; the defaults below are what the plugin uses when the row
carries no config.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Set to `false` to keep the bundle installed but idle. |
| `bootDelayMs` | `4000` | Delay after plugin load before scanning, so persistence and the session controller are ready. |
| `maxSessions` | `3` | Maximum sessions resumed per boot. |
| `staggerMs` | `1500` | Pause between two resumed sessions. |
| `serviceTimeoutMs` | `60000` | How long to wait for the session controller to appear. |
| `maxAttempts` | `2` | Consecutive recovery prompts allowed for one session before it is left alone. |
| `prompt` | Chinese continuation text | Follow-up message template; `{reason}` is replaced with the detected interruption. |

Example row config:

```yaml
- id: session-recovery
  name: dsh-session-recovery
  config:
    maxSessions: 2
    prompt: 'DSH restarted after {reason}. Continue the unfinished work, then summarize.'
```

## Permissions

The plugin needs no filesystem writes of its own. It uses these host services:

- `sessions` — read live sessions, flush a resumed session.
- `sessionQuery` — list persisted sessions.
- `sessionPersistence` — read raw session logs (falls back to `sessionQuery`).
- `sessionController` — resume a session through its controller.
- `agents` — reach the resumed agent to queue the follow-up turn.

It never creates, renames, or deletes sessions, never edits your files, and
never calls a tool on your behalf — it only asks the model to continue.

## Limitations

- Profiles without a session controller (some headless setups) cannot restore
  agents; the plugin logs a warning and does nothing.
- A session resumed this way starts a real model turn, so it consumes tokens
  and may block on an approval prompt the next time you open it.
- The scan runs once per process; a session that fails again later is picked up
  on the next restart.

# dsh-plugins

A collection of [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) plugins,
managed as a pnpm monorepo. Each plugin lives in its own package under
`packages/` and can be installed independently.

## Plugins

| Package | Directory | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-session-recovery` | `packages/session-recovery` | System maintenance: after a restart, resumes sessions whose last turn failed or never finished. |
| `dsh-sidebar-session-status` | `packages/sidebar-session-status` | Scaffold placeholder for a sidebar session-status plugin; not implemented yet. |

## Layout

```text
dsh-plugins/
├── packages/                 # one installable DSH bundle per directory
│   └── <plugin-name>/
│       ├── package.json      # declares dsh.bundle.patch
│       ├── cordis.patch.yml  # plugin rows added to a profile
│       ├── lib/index.js      # plugin entry point
│       └── README.md
├── scripts/
│   ├── new-plugin.mjs        # scaffold a plugin package
│   └── check-workspace.mjs   # validate package manifests and entry points
├── .github/workflows/ci.yml
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
```
